#### **[I won't sugarcoat this -- our opponents and their dark money allies are drowning us out on the air 10 to 1. We only have a few weeks until the primary, Marylanders are already casting their ballots, and I'm at risk of not being able to renew my ads. Please rush an emergency donation to help me save my ads:](https://substack.com/redirect/a950971e-b333-4504-ac88-6db8f4df6884?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Here's the thing:
1️⃣ We just got our first TV ads on the air this week, and we are still struggling to catch up and get our message out to voters across MD-05.
2️⃣ A super PAC that backs Trump's hand-picked candidates and election deniers is super-charging my opponent's campaign with a six-figure ad buy.
3️⃣ So now we're being outspent on ads 10:1, and that's a dangerous spot to be in less than 4 weeks out from the primary.
MAGA mega-donors are trying to buy this election like they did when I first ran for Congress in 2024. We CAN'T let it happen again. But if I can't raise $50,000 more to renew our ads by our end-of-month deadline, they'll dominate the airwaves and crush our chance to stand up to Donald Trump.
#### **[Can you chip in anything that works for you right now to help me fight back and win this race? Together, we can stop Trump's corruption in Congress:](https://substack.com/redirect/a950971e-b333-4504-ac88-6db8f4df6884?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Together,
Harry Dunn

body:
The best way to fight these attacks on voting and elections is by registering as many new voters as we can and getting them to vote in November.
Our program costs $3 per new voter. Join the movement with $30 or more right now to register new voters and more >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052926_4&amount=30]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Voter registration is a core part of how we fight back against suppression, folks.
How do we do it? We maximize your impact by focusing on the underserved and ignored portions of eligible voters. The unregistered, eligible citizens. Previous voters who let their registration lapse. Anyone who feels disregarded and disconnected from the political process.
Why them? Candidates and their political campaigns target those most likely to turn out. They hyper-focus on "persuadables" and "reliable partisans." Rather than trying to compete with their resources, we maximize your impact by speaking directly to Americans who feel left behind as they lose their fundamental rights.
We drive these eligible citizens to participation by helping them understand the stakes and showing how their vote matters . That's why our voter registration efforts are so important: Everyone should vote and feel invested in the outcome.
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. Will you step up with $30 or more today to help register 10 new voters? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052926_4&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052926_4&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052926_4&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052926_4&amount=50]

Unfortunately, we don't have anywhere near the resources to blanket the country with our efforts. Each election cycle, we target specific states where our efforts will make the greatest difference, like Nevada, North Carolina, or Michigan.
The key is getting these disenfranchised people -- always the first target of opponents of voting rights across the country -- to see the importance of voting now more than ever.
Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed over the last few years.
New voter registration -- at a cost to us of just about $3 per new voter -- is the whole ballgame. Can you pitch in with $30 or however much you can to help us register new voters ahead of registration deadlines? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052926_4&amount=30]

body:
Solidarity With Everyone Mourning the Loss of Juniper Blessing

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/kshamasawant/socialists-for-kshama-13701805?e=bbdb764b3a)
---
| | | | | |

**Fight for Trans Rights and****Safety for all LGBTQ+ People**
---
|
---
| |

**Solidarity With Everyone Mourning****the Loss of Juniper Blessing**
---
| | I stand in solidarity with the family and friends of University of Washington student Juniper Blessing. Condolences to all those mourning the loss of Juniper, who was brutally murdered recently in Seattle, while simply doing laundry. While the killer's motivations remain unclear, this horrific act of violence is still another reminder of the dangerous reality facing LGBTQ+ people everywhere, even in a supposed sanctuary city like Seattle. It needs to serve as a call to action to renewedly fight for justice for all our trans and queer siblings.
We need to build mass movements of working people to fight back against the right-wing, anti-trans attacks, and to defeat the anti-trans bills being advanced around the country.
---
|
---
| | I am endorsing the [No Hate in Washington State](https://us.list-manage.com/rp09s5sAT51?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) campaign, which is calling for a NO vote on two proposed appalling anti-trans ballot measures that threaten the rights of all children. **If passed, IL26-001 would deny basic protections for child abuse victims and IL26-628 would subject girls to invasive genital exams to play sports. It is absolutely crucial that working people and the labor movement ensure these measures are defeated by Washington State voters. The working class needs to stand in solidarity against every form of oppression as well as economic exploitation under the capitalist system.** My organization, Workers Strike Back, has also endorsed the campaign. Both Workers Strike Back and my revolutionary socialist campaign for the U.S. Congress will be doing everything we can to support the No Hate campaign.
Working people also need to set our sights beyond defending against attacks. We need to fight for major victories for LGBTQ+ people — this is the best way to defend against attacks and prevent them in the first place. The fight for LGBTQ+ people should go hand in hand with the fight to win historic change for working people of all genders and sexualities. Discrimination, oppression, and violence is endemic to capitalism because in order to squeeze billions of people for profit, the billionaires and multimillionaires need to keep the working class divided on gender, sexual orientation, race, religion and ethnicity, and citizenship status. We need to get united as the working class against the attempts of the right wing and billionaire class to divide us in order to keep exploiting us.
Working people are being squeezed on every front trying to afford housing, healthcare, and even groceries. Trans people, especially trans people of color, face violence and discrimination that make all those issues even worse. One in five trans people have been fired or denied a job for being trans and one in eight evicted or denied housing. One in five transgender individuals have experienced homelessness at some point in their lives.
**My independent revolutionary socialist campaign for Congress is fighting for and demanding:**
* End anti-trans and all LGBTQ+ oppression. Stop the advance of anti-trans bills, and go on the offensive to fight for full LGBTQ+ rights
* Free healthcare for all, including full access to all gender affirming and reproductive care and LGBTQ+ counseling services, funded by taxing the rich
* The Equality Act, which would amend the Civil Rights Act of 1964 (including titles II, III, IV, VI, VII, and IX) to prohibit discrimination on the basis of sex, sexual orientation and gender identity in employment, housing, public accommodations, education, federally funded programs, credit, and jury service
* Living-wage jobs guarantee and the right for all workers to unionize
* National rent control to stop the price-gouging by corporate landlords, which forces LGBTQ+ people out of their communities by economic eviction
* Create millions of affordable homes, including free emergency housing for trans and queer people fleeing abuse, funded by taxing the billionaires and the wealthiest corporations
* End all military aid to Israel and cut the trillion-dollar war budget to fund housing, education, and other social services
* AI-related regulations for the rights and safeguarding of queer children and adults.

The Republican Party has been the most direct in its attacks on trans people. Just in 2026, a shocking [44 anti-trans bills](https://us.list-manage.com/UbNhsTX4Wkr?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) have already been passed in 15 Republican-dominated states. Hundreds more bills are making their way through the legislatures of states across the nation. President Trump has attempted to carry out multiple [anti-trans executive orders](https://us.list-manage.com/hISCEXGHLPD?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15). These attempts [include](https://kshamasawant.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ef0e21448b54140a81773aff&id=09b96d0f49&e=bbdb764b3a) denying new passports to trans and nonbinary individuals, eliminating federal funding for schools that promote “indoctrination” based on “gender ideology and discriminatory equity ideology,” stopping healthcare to trans adolescents and young trans adults, banning trans girls from school sports, and erasing LGBTQ+ history by removing public health data from federal government websites, such as decades of HIV research and data on the mental health of girls and LGBTQ+ youth.
**Defeating Trump, the Republicans, and the right wing, however, will require independent movements with leadership prepared to fight against both the Republican and the Democratic parties.** Not only have the Democratic Party Congressmembers failed to defeat Trump, their own betrayals of working people have opened the door to the two Trump presidencies in the first place.
Trump and the Republicans have demonized LGBTQ+ people in order to deflect genuine anger working people feel against the billionaires. But Democratic politicians have not fought for LGBTQ+ rights in any meaningful way, and instead have used superficial and performative rhetoric while betraying queer and all working people. Several Democratic Congressmembers pay lip service to LGBTQ+ issues, but they have not won, or led on, any substantive victories. Now, many prominent Democrats have started abandoning even those empty promises to pivot rightward for careerist reasons.
**In 1996, 118 House and 32 Senate Democrats voted in favor of the anti-LGBTQ+ Defense of Marriage Act, which defines marriage as between a man and a woman.** Democratic President Bill Clinton signed it into law. Even in 2008 in his Presidential campaign, Democratic candidate Barack Obama [said](https://us.list-manage.com/MuOjJHcrW15?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15), "I believe marriage is between a man and a woman. I am not in favor of gay marriage." In Seattle in 2013, I was the only City Council or Mayoral candidate or elected official who publicly stood with the first-ever Trans Pride march. No Democratic Party candidate or elected official was willing to support it.
Last year, Gavin Newsom said it is "deeply unfair" for trans women to participate in women's sports. During the 2024 Presidential election, Democratic candidate Kamala Harris, when asked if transgender Americans should have access to gender affirming care, said merely, "I believe we should follow the law." This was in a context in which hundreds of anti-trans bills were being advanced nationally. In a 2022 Financial Times interview, when asked about the "transgender debate," Hilary Clinton said: "We are standing on the precipice of losing our democracy, and everything that everybody else cares about then goes out the window. The most important thing is to win the next election. Whatever does not help you win should not be a priority."
**My main opponent, 29-year Democratic Congressmember Adam Smith pays lip service to LGBTQ+ rights, while his actions have been geared towards attacking working people (including the queer community), promoting war, and serving the profiteering billionaires.** Smith was [one of 51 House Democrats](https://us.list-manage.com/3fADLIT074G?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) who voted for hundreds of billions of dollars in cuts to Medicare and Medicaid in 1997, as part of Bill Clinton’s Balanced Budget Act. This bill also opened the door to the privatization of Medicare. Under both Republican President Bush and Democratic President Obama, Adam Smith repeatedly voted to bail out the big banks after the Great Recession, which plundered the millions who faced home foreclosures and handed over tens of billions of dollars worth of real estate to private equity. This bipartisan robbery against working people is a big reason why rents have been skyrocketing. In 2011, Adam Smith voted to cut billions of dollars from publicly funded rent controlled housing. Smith voted to break the strike of the Railroad workers in 2022. He has voted to create and fund ICE and to fund tens of billions of dollars for the genocide in Gaza.
**Even a Democratic Party strategist, Charlotte Clymer, who is also a trans activist,**[**admitted in 2025**](https://us.list-manage.com/Ug2JSFRTogz?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)**: “We’ve been largely abandoned by the Democratic Party... Looking at the past six months or so, it’s become pretty clear that most federal Democratic lawmakers have no clear or obvious intention in standing beside trans people in this critical moment.”**
Throughout history, the ruling classes have systematically used a divide-and-conquer strategy in order to keep the exploited masses atomized and subjugated. The early American and European capitalists manufactured the false and destructive racist ideology of Black and indigenous inferiority in order to exploit Black people as slaves, to carry out the genocide of indigenous people, and to keep white, Black, indigenous, and other immigrant workers divided and pitted against each other, diverting the blame for their miserable conditions away from those in power. Similarly, it is in the interest of the billionaires and multimillionaires today to prevent progress on LGBTQ+ rights and to promote bigoted and divisive ideologies.
Under the pressure of mass protests, including the George Floyd rebellion, billionaires and big corporations were forced to set up superficial programs of “inclusion” in relation to people of color, women, and the LGBTQ+ community. As movements have lost ground, It’s not surprising to see billionaires like Mark Zuckerberg blatantly roll back even the minimal policies they had put in place. This shows that the liberation of oppressed people or the working class as a whole will never come about via corporate “inclusion” programs that allow a wealthy few to make lucrative careers while the overwhelming majority of the oppressed are left behind.
**The only way LGBTQ+ and other oppressed people have achieved any progress is through independent working-class mass protests and civil disobedience.** The movement for LGBTQ+ liberation was really kicked off by trans, gay, and lesbian working people in multiracial fightback against harassment by New York City police in the historic 1969 Stonewall Rebellion. It was further mass action by the rank and file of the movement that won marriage equality and many other LGBTQ+ rights.
The LGBTQ+ movements at the time were strong also because they happened in the context of nationwide labor strike actions and powerful movements to end the Vietnam War and for women’s and Black rights. Many of the rank-and-file leaders of these movements were independent of both the Democratic and Republican parties and identified as revolutionary socialists. Mass action for LGBTQ+ rights today will be stronger if we also build mass movements to end imperialist wars, including ending military funding to Israel, to cut the military budget to fund housing, jobs, and education, and to win free healthcare for all by taxing the rich.
The fight for LGBTQ+ rights is also linked with these larger struggles because the disproportionate poverty, housing instability and healthcare disparity faced by queer people can only begin to change if we fight for affordable housing, free healthcare for all, full funding of services, and living-wage jobs, along with anti-discrimination laws. To win any of this, we will need independent mass working-class movements with leadership that will fight the billionaires and both their parties.
During my decade as the sole socialist on a Seattle City Council filled with Democratic Party politicians, I consistently used my office to fight for queer and trans working people, often facing the sharp opposition of the Council Democrats. In partnership with the [Gender Justice League](https://us.list-manage.com/854iYMWll9P?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) and other LGBTQ+ organizations, my office hosted a landmark [LGBTQ+ Hate Crimes Forum](https://us.list-manage.com/74BgrVs6xS3?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) in 2015, attended by hundreds of people, to highlight the surge in hate crimes against the queer community. This forum had so much public support that it forced the [Democratic establishment](https://us.list-manage.com/15Df3Jlsk68?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) to attend and [take steps](https://us.list-manage.com/PiEUojKdGfx?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) following the forum. Alongside leaders like Danni Askini of the Gender Justice League and Marsha Botzer of the Ingersoll Gender Center, my office passed [proclamations](https://us.list-manage.com/UVWk0epmrdp?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) in consecutive years for Trans Pride Day. The movement, with the leadership of trans rights organizations and my office, won hundreds of thousands of dollars for an LGBTQ+ senior center in the heart of Capitol Hill, Seattle’s historically queer-friendly neighborhood, an LGBTQ+ wellness center at NOVA High School, and other trans community services.

---
|
---
| | Through my office, we won Seattle’s Amazon Tax, which raises hundreds of millions of dollars annually for affordable housing by taxing the city’s wealthiest corporations. We also fought for and won an additional $20 million expansion of the tax to fund student mental health services in the Seattle Public School system. Affordable housing and affordable access to gender-inclusive healthcare and mental health services, as my campaign is fighting for now, are disproportionately needed by the queer and trans communities.
**I am the only candidate in the race with the track record of fighting and winning for LGBTQ+ rights. I am also the only candidate in this race fighting for demands that would dramatically improve the lives of queer and trans community members.**
**We need a new political party for the multigender, multiracial working class to organize mass struggles against the rich and their political servants. Fighting for our campaign to win our election to the U.S. Congress will be a historic breakthrough towards that goal.**
Our fight is not only against corporate politicians or the right wing, but against the capitalist system itself that thrives on attacking oppressed communities and all working people in order to further enrich an already grotesquely wealthy billionaire class.
Solidarity,Kshama
---
|

We’re also fighting for a new party for the working class!

The early American and European capitalists manufactured the false and destructive racist ideology of Black and indigenous inferiority in order to exploit Black people as slaves, to carry out the genocide of indigenous people, and to keep white, Black, indigenous, and other immigrant workers divided and pitted against each other, diverting the blame for their miserable conditions away from those in power. Similarly, it is in the interest of the billionaires and multimillionaires today to prevent progress on LGBTQ+ rights and to promote bigoted and divisive ideologies. Under the pressure of mass protests, including the George Floyd rebellion, billionaires and big corporations were forced to set up superficial programs of “inclusion” in relation to people of color, women, and the LGBTQ+ community. As movements have lost ground, It’s not surprising to see billionaires like Mark Zuckerberg blatantly roll back even the minimal policies they had put in place. This shows that the liberation of oppressed people or the working class as a whole will never come about via corporate “inclusion” programs that allow a wealthy few to make lucrative careers while the overwhelming majority of the oppressed are left behind. The only way LGBTQ+ and other oppressed people have achieved any progress is through independent working-class mass protests and civil disobedience. The movement for LGBTQ+ liberation was really kicked off by trans, gay, and lesbian working people in multiracial fightback against harassment by New York City police in the historic 1969 Stonewall Rebellion. It was further mass action by the rank and file of the movement that won marriage equality and many other LGBTQ+ rights. The LGBTQ+ movements at the time were strong also because they happened in the context of nationwide labor strike actions and powerful movements to end the Vietnam War and for women’s and Black rights. Many of the rank-and-file leaders of these movements were independent of both the Democratic and Republican parties and identified as revolutionary socialists. Mass action for LGBTQ+ rights today will be stronger if we also build mass movements to end imperialist wars, including ending military funding to Israel, to cut the military budget to fund housing, jobs, and education, and to win free healthcare for all by taxing the rich. The fight for LGBTQ+ rights is also linked with these larger struggles because the disproportionate poverty, housing instability and healthcare disparity faced by queer people can only begin to change if we fight for affordable housing, free healthcare for all, full funding of services, and living-wage jobs, along with anti-discrimination laws. To win any of this, we will need independent mass working-class movements with leadership that will fight the billionaires and both their parties. During my decade as the sole socialist on a Seattle City Council filled with Democratic Party politicians, I consistently used my office to fight for queer and trans working people, often facing the sharp opposition of the Council Democrats. In partnership with the and other LGBTQ+ organizations, my office hosted a landmark in 2015, attended by hundreds of people, to highlight the surge in hate crimes against the queer community. This forum had so much public support that it forced the to attend and following the forum. Alongside leaders like Danni Askini of the Gender Justice League and Marsha Botzer of the Ingersoll Gender Center, my office passed in consecutive years for Trans Pride Day. The movement, with the leadership of trans rights organizations and my office, won hundreds of thousands of dollars for an LGBTQ+ senior center in the heart of Capitol Hill, Seattle’s historically queer-friendly neighborhood, an LGBTQ+ wellness center at NOVA High School, and other trans community services. | | | Through my office, we won Seattle’s Amazon Tax, which raises hundreds of millions of dollars annually for affordable housing by taxing the city’s wealthiest corporations. We also fought for and won an additional $20 million expansion of the tax to fund student mental health services in the Seattle Public School system. Affordable housing and affordable access to gender-inclusive healthcare and mental health services, as my campaign is fighting for now, are disproportionately needed by the queer and trans communities. I am the only candidate in the race with the track record of fighting and winning for LGBTQ+ rights. I am also the only candidate in this race fighting for demands that would dramatically improve the lives of queer and trans community members. We need a new political party for the multigender, multiracial working class to organize mass struggles against the rich and their political servants. Fighting for our campaign to win our election to the U.S. Congress will be a historic breakthrough towards that goal. Our fight is not only against corporate politicians or the right wing, but against the capitalist system itself that thrives on attacking oppressed communities and all working people in order to further enrich an already grotesquely wealthy billionaire class. Solidarity,Kshama | | | | | | | | | | | | | Help us build an independent fightback against anti-trans and all LGBTQ+ oppression, and to win free healthcare for all, a living-wage jobs guarantee, national rent control, and millions of affordable homes. We’re fighting to shut down ICE, end all military aid to Israel, and stop the data centers and AI-related layoffs. We’re also fighting for a new party for the working class! | | The billionaires and their two parties will fight tooth and nail to keep Kshama out of Congress because they know she is a real fighter for working people. We need everyone to get involved to get the word out in order to be able to defeat them! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2026 Kshama for Congress. All rights reserved._

subject: An insider NM poll just landed
body:
Plus: Comply with our illegal law — or we'll sue you. Only in NM | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |

| | | | | |
New Mexico Democrats passed an anti-ICE law — and now they're threatening to sue their own counties over the very law the DOJ is suing the state for. [We break down the hypocrisy.](https://us.list-manage.com/Xefn71Q6TQC?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
**Then we switch gears completely:** ER veteran [Jalayne Faulhaber](https://us.list-manage.com/tORBi6wmgSb?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) joins us to bust the HRT, GLP-1, and testosterone myths that keep people scared — starting with the 2002 study that misled a whole generation of women.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/14uXPEecBp7?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🏛️ **DEMS THREATEN COUNTIES OVER A LAW THE DOJ IS SUING THEM FOR**
House Bill 9 — the "Immigrant Safety Act" — bars New Mexico counties from cooperating with ICE. Otero County signed a five-year contract and told Santa Fe exactly where to put it.
Now Democratic leaders are warning those counties: fall in line, or get sued.
The problem? The federal government is already suing the state over the same law. And one Democratic senator said something in that hearing that quietly gives the whole game away.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/dkZFsp1jDwV?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
🔥 **"NORMAL" LABS — AND STILL FEELING TERRIBLE**
Krysty had done all the bloodwork. Every result came back "normal." She still wasn't sleeping, the weight wouldn't budge, and the joint pain wouldn't quit.
Jalayne explains the difference between "normal" and "optimal" — and why one number told a completely different story than Krysty's old doctor did.
**Then there's HRT. That single 2002 study scared a generation of women away from it. Jalayne breaks down what she says it got wrong — hear it before you make up your mind.
** ⚠️ **THE VIAL LABELED "RESEARCH ONLY"**
GLP-1s are everywhere now — and so is the temptation to buy them cheap online.
One of Jalayne's patients did exactly that. The first injection, she was fine. The second one, she passed out in her driveway and ended up in the ER.
What was actually in that vial — and why "too good to be true" almost always is.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/nxPebd4ZxSD?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |

PLUS: Mark reads the column from the Santa Fe writer who spent 2022 trashing him — wait until you hear what the critic finally admits. And for the guys: why "normal" testosterone might be exactly why you crash every afternoon at 3 p.m.

🩺 **WORK WITH JALAYNE**
Our guest is Jalayne Faulhaber, FNP, at Foundation Health & Wellness in Albuquerque.

California Democrats are suddenly organizing for TWO major special elections:
➡️ CA-01
➡️ CA-14
And all of this is happening while we are only DAYS away from California’s Primary Election on June 2.
That means our organizers, volunteers, voter protection teams, and turnout programs are being stretched across multiple critical elections all at once.
Please, will you rush a donation right now to help us keep organizing programs fully funded through the Primary Election and these special elections? Control of the U.S. House will almost certainly come down to these races. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cdp-may26-special?&refcode=&amount=]

name: Danielle Bethell
subject: Help End Oregon's Death Tax
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Danielle Bethell PAC 20220 [Preferences](https://daniellebethell
body:
I support IP 51, the effort to end Oregon’s estate tax.
[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auhhitk-hhlrhljhit-r/) Friends,As County Commissioner, and in my campaign for Governor, I've spent a lot of time talking with Oregon families, farmers, ranchers, and small business owners over the years, and one thing I hear again and again is how hard it has become to build something that can actually be passed down to the next generation.People work their entire lives to build a family business, protect a farm, save for their kids and grandkids, and leave something behind for the people they love. After a lifetime of paying taxes, the last thing government should do is force families to sell land, break apart businesses, or lose generational assets just to pay another tax after a loved one passes away.**That 's why I support IP 51, the effort to end Oregon's estate tax.**Oregon remains one of the few states in the country with a state-level death tax, and it hurts family farms, small businesses, and people who simply want to keep what they've worked their whole lives to build.I believe:
* Families should be able to pass down farms, homes, businesses, and savings without government penalty.
* Oregon should encourage entrepreneurship, investment, and long-term family stability.
* Retirees and seniors should not feel pushed out of Oregon because of unfair tax policies.
* Family-owned businesses should have the opportunity to survive from one generation to the next.

**Right now, supporters are working to qualify IP 51 for the ballot, and they need help gathering signatures quickly.**[Linked here is the official petition sheet](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auhhitk-hhlrhljhit-y/). Here's how you can help:
1. Download and print [the linked form](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auhhitk-hhlrhljhit-j/).
2. Sign the petition in ink.
3. Feel free to print extra copies for friends or family.
4. **Mail completed petition sheets to: PO Box 12249, Salem, OR 97309**

Petitions cannot be faxed or emailed.Timing matters here, so please try to **mail your signed petition sheet by June 15.** If you have questions, you can email [info@endthedeathtax.com](mailto:info@endthedeathtax.com).I'm proud to support this effort because I believe Oregon should be a place where families can build a future, not a place where government stands in the way of passing that future on.Thank you,Danielle Bethell

After a lifetime of paying taxes, the last thing government should do is force families to sell land, break apart businesses, or lose generational assets just to pay another tax after a loved one passes away.That 's why I support IP 51, the effort to end Oregon's estate tax.Oregon remains one of the few states in the country with a state-level death tax, and it hurts family farms, small businesses, and people who simply want to keep what they've worked their whole lives to build.I believe: Families should be able to pass down farms, homes, businesses, and savings without government penalty. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. ## Trump Set To Decide on Iran Deal
President Trump said Friday he [would make a final decision](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2SrCAUBOCnwQwLwd-A4CZmc9MNrSMcxrOLYgHqzjz9lvsKG3dVV3_98ZgeQJ62539YUWcXpg2v5DFnjBNF2CwaShS2Gd8hxWC-MOP3JIVsuWi4EpMF8q-pLqx2iBJVgbrqelGppu2bYtEOemgB6kGawdmqquuqm2XXGQVCDZ0rSN9tolGiEqIXddm1g3JSNWbAWTkUrBZoKYdYfgba8oLOv8KJsTRhLbxect4TU_-YHJkcr-sqzZxuxZ0zOXo6kR-7hYyJyfFG8QsiPxLP8Vh3fsJmkBuEhI4i8pQjUObB8SXE9Xhzi-C58SEhk2MRtd0v8p5S27FaPFcg_zsl_-m_U8ufAAAA__8xRYb5) on a deal with Iran that would reopen the Strait of Hormuz and commit Tehran to destroying its roughly 900 pounds of highly-enriched uranium. No decision was announced by midnight ET, but earllier Vice President JD Vance said the sides were "very close" but "not there yet," while Iran's Foreign Ministry said Friday there were "no negotiations" on its nuclear program. An Iranian state media report called Trump's Truth Social post [a "mixture of truth and lies."](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OpDAQhJ8GMqPG5s-Bg0vI5tILkXE3M31nbGR7hpt9-hUr7RNsVqqSSvXVn9tys-w53H_bnUzZ4hLozJ5KobRwsgHJceYYVvqIOUX3jwr9XyTIQUAvFCxo2b-XrkazEUlSNZl2nKBV_TD19cNoVFpj28Ig1bTKVSoAQmy3VY_S6qFmc7VBr6AFmKBrxkGrTareaVrVRlB1QMglpuZv5FAetPl3fFFqXNxrbx6lHLlSvyo5V3I-z7MJq7sorvxyYvJYyXlnRE-CbC6VnD2_SKw-3r_180BbKIsLWpw2iZKe-yGQrBfZBlc4hiySC1Z1Y6fHOhk8Tvae8zBWHdx3y_5rUvnRjy8jPwMAAP__Z0KIYQ) In the [Truth Social post](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAUheGnMVuiCxewPTBUqrylU6WOFoFLTIuNBSRp-vRV-gpdz5G-4f84zScbU9wub3Yl00KeN7rXRK1RmWOxmycXa8zbmX5yLdl9UaPvWYDQB1AHhNnbmB6zZN4EIkHIyPB-AI5KD4otJvTKk3fOSwG9IGfPHr1E7TDwnktk0Tw1UAgcYAB57PWIQaByI50xEHQSyMeWy_Ezx60tFNIj36gcXV5ZMktre-3wpRNTJ6ZWrm2p2UWbnv9zlFDIpte82eTfy3XdOzHtubbaiYlzrdUgBY7jMAoYAFkxfr_HlGLVfSfhstr4R7H2rz43I34DAAD___OaeBM), Trump demanded Iran never build a nuclear weapon, open the strait immediately without tolls, clear its mines, and surrender its uranium for destruction by the U.S.
## Key Moonshot Rocket Explodes
Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket was destroyed in a massive launchpad explosion Thursday night during during an unmanned pre-launch engine test at Cape Canaveral, a major setback for Jeff Bezos' space venture. [Watch video of the explosion here.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LtOwzAUxvGncbZGx7dcBg-VUAdEYaxgsVz7uDngxpXjNpSnR-UVWL9P-g3_w97uHSWaT6_ujKbGbGdcl4S1YrFU3BzQ00J5PuJPXkr2X1jx2woQ3Qb0RoINjtLdqiaYiChQNmh4PwCXuht0M5kQldID11FwdFJH1QWtwfWjAkQMviHz0EBL4AADqLbvRhmF1H7Eo4wITAEGqrm0n5nmOmFM93zD0vp8bpKZar0sTG6Z2DGxW9e1vedrvR7x8T8WV_3E5O7G5BN_G-Hw8bx9efdNMeGyUkq0dD1TcDo7Sn9k_VeHmxG_AQAA__8pSXDl) The 320-foot rocket [erupted in a fireball ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L-O4yAQx_GnwR0WBvyvoMjpRJdrrrjrLGzG9mQxWEDiZJ9-5ewjbD3S6Pf5_rsOV4MO_fLHbKDyHAYPR3KQM8QBo_EWJkwY_AifIcUwfUCG58AZbyirqWCDNehegyysmgE4iAJU1XasEnXT1cWqRm66vu7q1oLsjDD9bJisoB1bK5tKtgWq8xurBasY65gs26YXMxf11MMoZmBEMrCYQyxvAX1eYXav8IBYTmErnFpz3hMRF8I14fo4jnJL_rwRrsHTeyJcZ5hWH1xYXoTrBTxE4wjXbxQd3R1oiLigpy4kSPTbSdFTeO4unH4aPHXm7qd1N5ZwbSK9XLi8xf8VETpMaIn4_esMCUf6C3EvorL7gc5haloi2bIZdO_J-UedH4p_BQAA__9oTpPb)during a static fire test, where engines are ignited briefly on the ground, ahead of a planned June satellite launch. ## List: Nursing Home Costs in Every State
A new map of [median nursing home costs](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuSozAQAL8GMlGDhDAOFFxC5ksvpAY0MnOrByXJZr1fv-X9hc27uqv63225IXuO978YyFSXlkhn8VQr5YUzRksbF05xpa9Ucto-qNLnIkGOArRQsFhk_1qG1hpHJEm1ZPrLBL3S46Tb3WAvEVbUUz-Og5XXcZI0uHVFCVpbWls2bxtoBT3ABEN3Ga_KSaW3K63KETQDkOWacvc_caw7Of9KT8rdlkLrzV7rURr1p5FzI-fzPLsnlwf6DQ-u6LnUN9jIOeBxkBXnTpkEBsq8YSziwJeoO4mQShUuZREfuXC8iz0FKo2c22zscbL3XMZLM8A9IPufeP3VsaeR3wEAAP__Xl2Ckg) in every state shows Americans face wildly different bills depending on where they age, with Alaska topping the nation at nearly $334,000 per year for a semi-private room. That's nearly five times the median cost in Texas, the least expensive state for nursing home care at roughly $68,000. Coastal states like Connecticut, Hawaii, New York, and Oregon cluster near the top, while the Midwest and South offer the most affordable options. Nationwide, the median runs about $9,800 per month for a semi-private room--and with 94% of facilities reporting major staffing shortages, prices are expected to keep climbing as America's population ages. ---|---|---
Democratic gubernatorial candidate Troy Jackson is receiving support from a PAC funded by a variety of out-of-state organizations and a foreign-born, Illinois-based stock-trading millionaire despite positioning himself as a "clean money" candidate opposing rich "oligarchs".
[RELATED: [Bangor Hands Out $336k in Grants to "Food and Medicine" That Employed Troy Jackson And Campaigned for Liberal City Councilors...](https://substack.com/redirect/30c06114-3858-422b-b5d1-342b00a1fae4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)]
"The oligarchs who run this system want to work us to death. They want to monetize every moment of our lives and squeeze every dime out of our labor. That wheel they have us chasing all the damn time? We built it. On June 9th, we're taking it back," said Jackson in a social media post on May 29.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/6ef5cfdf-582c-4d69-8d76-9e0c185b5715?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Jackson has also previously taken the "[People's Pledge](https://substack.com/redirect/fafbe3c6-ea15-4d2f-8e5f-344df9ecfc49?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," saying that he will not take any "dark money" or any "corporate money into this race."
Jackson's vocal opposition to "oligarchs" and corporate money rings hollow after a look at his campaign finances and the finances of the [Working Mainers First PAC](https://substack.com/redirect/884bed56-bef3-41eb-9d9b-e5238acf629c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) supporting his candidacy.
## William Connell and Allston Trading
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/124a0d1a-bac0-4805-ac57-1972a7f68dd9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Image of Connell from Patriotic Millionaires
According to his most recent campaign [finance report](https://substack.com/redirect/c992fa2e-828c-47df-8b5c-76e63203565f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with the Maine Ethics Commission-only current as of January 2026-Jackson's campaign directly received $2,500 from William "Liam" Connell, an investment-firm founder and millionaire living in a $6 million mansion in Lake Forest, Illinois.
Connell is also one of the largest contributors to the Working Mainers First PAC, whose explicit purpose is supporting Jackson's bid for the Blaine House.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1c63b51a-17d3-41a4-aa47-3fcc07b7647f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Connell donated $50,000 to the pro-Jackson PAC.
Connell is a member of the Patriotic Millionaires Research Center, a left-wing alliance of rich left-wing activists fighting to raise taxes, increase the minimum wage, and, ironically, to [reduce the role of wealth and money in politics](https://substack.com/redirect/79e7a591-a171-421a-9f08-5ebb6ea313c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
He has [donated](https://substack.com/redirect/867ec115-e3d0-407f-81f0-b13b7a6039ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) many thousands of dollars to left-wing PACs and candidates across both state and federal elections in his home state and across the country, suggesting that he is, in fact, one of the political oligarchs Jackson has vowed to oppose.
According to his bio on their website, Connell was born in Ireland and first moved to the U.S. at the age of 28, where he promptly began working on Wall Street. He founded "several algorithmic trading firms."
"Right now, I am interested in strategic activism to counter the long-term campaign by the wealthy to hoard their wealth and power," says his bio.
He founded the investment company Allston Trading, a stock trading and investment firm. According to his bio, he retired in 2013. The company was sold in 2021 and no longer exists as a distinct business entity.
That claim is, however, contradicted by [campaign ](https://substack.com/redirect/867ec115-e3d0-407f-81f0-b13b7a6039ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)donor data, which shows that he was listed as a trader for Allston at least as recently as October 2018, and as the business' CEO at least as recently as 2015, though other donations from those times do list him as being retired.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/41584b53-9970-4ffc-a86f-1e8c4b0318f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Allston itself has a checkered history. According to a 2025 [report ](https://substack.com/redirect/215a52d9-28f9-4428-ac8e-50c0c65bfa29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)from Morningstar, the investment firm faced an investigation from the United States Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) from 2014-2015, a special grand jury investigation from 2017-2018 from the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Chicago area, and a 2020 criminal probe from the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ).
Notably, the report claims that when the firm was purchased amid its string of controversies, the buyers "only extended offers to a minority of Allston's former traders who met our rigorous standards."
A Bloomberg [report ](https://substack.com/redirect/d6af6577-41c9-4427-b926-2078d531f58a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)claimed that the criminal probe was evaluating the possibility of market manipulation committed by the firm, though an Allston spokesman told the outlet that they were not accused of illegal conduct and fully cooperated with the probe.
Allston has also faced civil lawsuits.
## Working Mainers First
According to Working Mainers First's 11-day pre-primary report, filed on May 29, the PAC has received a total of $543,000 in contributions.
The PAC has drawn [hundreds of thousands](https://substack.com/redirect/884bed56-bef3-41eb-9d9b-e5238acf629c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from a variety of PAC arms of labor unions, nationally and locally, and some with seemingly no reason to donate to a Maine race.
The PAC drew $20,000 from the IBEW Local 1253 Cope Fund, $100,000 from the Massachusetts-based Elevator Construction Local 4 Peoples Action Committee, and $2,000 from the California Nurses Association Political Action Committee, among many other labor union-adjacent organizations.
Jackson has historically worked to draw support from labor unions.
In Maine, PACs are allowed to spend an unlimited amount in support of a candidate but are not meant to [coordinate](https://substack.com/redirect/6b34d850-be4f-4230-8329-85b133e4994a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with the campaign of a candidate they support. If they do coordinate, the funds they used are meant to be considered as direct contributions to the candidate.
While it is impossible to determine how much, if any, direct coordination Jackson's campaign has had with the Working Mainers First PAC, its [principal officer](https://substack.com/redirect/8d77be69-b909-477a-b053-8786c5624002?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has suspiciously close links with the candidate.
[Max Rush](https://substack.com/redirect/4113dcbb-ca37-4340-9716-6284f52b3f14?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the PAC's principal officer, works at the Portland-based [FRAME Strategies](https://substack.com/redirect/1e928c7c-3f40-4481-a76b-78b67ef6f79b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a public relations firm that helps run left-wing political campaigns.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2503988d-59fd-4a38-a57e-04ab2d2415b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Image of Rush from FRAME's website
Prior to his work with FRAME, Rush worked very closely with Jackson and served as his chief of staff from 2021-2024 when Jackson was serving as Maine State Senate President.
His prior close working relationship with Jackson raises questions about how separate his PAC really is from the candidate's campaign.
The PAC's authorized agent, Lora Haggard, is a partner at Blue Wave, a national consulting firm that specializes in campaign finance compliance and fundraising.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0bf3f877-1179-4c97-af40-c0e87bf0f2f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Image of Haggard from Blue Wave
According to her bio, Haggard has served as the treasurer for four (unsuccessful) presidential campaigns, including Sen. Bernie Sanders' (I-VT.) 2016 and 2020 runs.

Working Mainers First According to Working Mainers First's 11-day pre-primary report, filed on May 29, the PAC has received a total of $543,000 in contributions. The PAC has drawn from a variety of PAC arms of labor unions, nationally and locally, and some with seemingly no reason to donate to a Maine race. The PAC drew $20,000 from the IBEW Local 1253 Cope Fund, $100,000 from the Massachusetts-based Elevator Construction Local 4 Peoples Action Committee, and $2,000 from the California Nurses Association Political Action Committee, among many other labor union-adjacent organizations. Jackson has historically worked to draw support from labor unions. In Maine, PACs are allowed to spend an unlimited amount in support of a candidate but are not meant to with the campaign of a candidate they support. If they do coordinate, the funds they used are meant to be considered as direct contributions to the candidate. While it is impossible to determine how much, if any, direct coordination Jackson's campaign has had with the Working Mainers First PAC, its has suspiciously close links with the candidate. , the PAC's principal officer, works at the Portland-based , a public relations firm that helps run left-wing political campaigns. | | ---|---|--- Image of Rush from FRAME's website Prior to his work with FRAME, Rush worked very closely with Jackson and served as his chief of staff from 2021-2024 when Jackson was serving as Maine State Senate President. His prior close working relationship with Jackson raises questions about how separate his PAC really is from the candidate's campaign. The PAC's authorized agent, Lora Haggard, is a partner at Blue Wave, a national consulting firm that specializes in campaign finance compliance and fundraising. | | ---|---|--- Image of Haggard from Blue Wave According to her bio, Haggard has served as the treasurer for four (unsuccessful) presidential campaigns, including Sen. | Who is Leonard Leo?
He has never appeared on a ballot. He does not seek the spotlight. He is the Chairman of the Federalist Society and operates in the shadows. And from those shadows he has done incomprehensible damage to American democracy.
Leonard Leo built the Supreme Court's extremist conservative majority. He placed Gorsuch, Kavanaugh, and Barrett on the court. And when Trump gets to replace two or three of the oldest justices, which he is already preparing to do, Leonard Leo will choose their replacements.
Here is what Leo's court has already delivered: Roe overturned. Trump granted criminal immunity. Citizens United enabled. The Voting Rights Act gutted. Federal regulatory power dismantled. That is not a full list. It is barely the beginning. Leonard Leo is the reason you are angry. He's the reason for our polarized politics, the corruption with no accountability, the rights that have been stripped away, the dysfunction that feels permanent. He did not cause all of it. But he built the judicial infrastructure that made all of it possible, and that is making all of it permanent.

| And then he came for the states.
Leo spent a decade doing to state Supreme Courts exactly what he did to SCOTUS, because state courts decide voting rights, reproductive freedom, and the maps that determine who controls Congress. We were watching. We beat his machine in Pennsylvania and Wisconsin. Both times he came with his network and his money. Both times we beat him.
The state court firewall is essential. But it is not enough while Leo's Supreme Court keeps changing the rules. The only permanent answer is to unpack the court he built, and the Constitution gives us that power. Congress has changed the number of justices seven times. No amendment required.
Leo has a thirty year head start, billions in dark money cash, and a Supreme Court that has already chosen his side. But we have hundreds of thousands of Democrats who have pitched in to defeat him twice. We like our odds. But we need you with us for what comes next: the Kansas ballot initiative, November Supreme Court elections, the 2026 midterms, and the sustained campaign to reform the court that made all of this possible. ## Meth, Gun Bust Nets 14 Arrests
A joint federal-state investigation into methamphetamine and firearms trafficking in and around Palestine, Texas, has led to [14 arrests](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD3OpDAQRE9jMiPb_AcONiGbTTdEDW6gd4w9sntg5vYr9gpfVqWSnkrvz2N6AHkK22840PJnjVPAK3tkxjRlfjsMnBPm5Y1ugwM7joG2ySjTStXISk0OyH-nunB2Vm7QBVrd9UpX_dBVxW571SndDkvdrwCo-3pxzTq3yjSLc33XF2RvmGoqpbUyjSk7o2Fu5rVChLnFQdQKHXFMJe_I-IG8-m88MZVLPApvd-ZXFtUvYUZhxuu6yqfn8x6FGW-2MKNq7jwIM-paQkqYGZ38GymwPJB3ub2D5ATrSsuTwiYpnJiZNmCKQb7A3y2gMGORrHtd5D3lthO12g4g__8K_0zgac2_AAAA__-uRIVu) and dozens of felony charges, police said Friday. The Palestine Police Department worked the case alongside the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives; Homeland Security Investigations; and the Texas Department of Public Safety. Charges range from conspiracy to distribute meth to felon-in-possession and carrying firearms in furtherance of drug trafficking, with several suspects [facing multiple counts](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2ypCAUxfHVYIbFp2hgMInZm3RC6wIXmxrULri2r3c_1bOFt4FTv_P_87V-QS752H7DjjN9p3M98G4FibCuja6IB7WKLVwYN9jR0XnkbVVCDVxYrsUaIZf3aro4exEn2eEs3SikHienu8dsphGHoFMSxg1xgmSjcyaYMfo0aG26PH_GhNVCSqGs6p2S4K1PGhH8gBMzAmOms_b0QMJvaKm8zxfWPpx7V-YH0bMx_Yuphanlvu8--Cannl5MLVAph4JMLZ9fTC3lDFCYWqThEMLVMPIzcaqQUg5_87HxHenBt-to_AkFG-UDOVQEphYrJPc2aC8AuHEmceON5SCd4h-tSQNoZ8euzvF551JyGxwzYtshl_9c-lnk16z-BQAA__-YV49h).
## Waymo Dominates Texas Robotaxi Race
New Texas data shows [Waymo's dominance](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LvO5CAMBeCnIR0jINcpKLZJ92-7ZWTASSwRGIEzl7dfZV7h7yz56NPR-fez_ABFSttfONDye81LwleNyIxlqXwGTFwLVn9i2ODAkXOibTHKDFL1slVLAIqfpWuCdSrcdYNWj5PS7XQf22a3fadd33dOh9UbjXoKw9S51QH6oAbXNWQvTPWt0lqZ3txGo8H1bm0RwQ14F53CQJzLjXdkfENd4yc_sdx8Pppod-ZHFe0fYWZhZka_-3Imv19vYeZLF2ZW_XVPwswv-BxZhnxQAsYqv6SEk3PKRz6rfOJOPqIsuFHlAkw5VQlXskaQXIBilQ53SkGYuSk2PF4UI9VhFJ3aDqD47ca_W_Rpzf8AAAD__xK8jSs): 577 authorized driverless vehicles statewide, while Tesla has just 42. The figures come from a state registration law that [took effect May 28](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykzzGO6yAQANDT2F2sYTAmLijSpMsv_5YWhDFBAhPBxE5uv9q9wl7gSe_rttxsTHEL_2wmw--1LBsdLREz1aXxy9PGrVK7v8gHm0lz2WJYEHA6gTpJWLyN6bOMvTcO_Cx6MkKfQcjzrGX_MCOg0DDDqO5oz-TUtHpApXHVTjox9dH8YKAkCAGocNAorFNulUTWTTR3I5CPXOrAD2J627amT9mpDveS-2QezM_WyUuH1w6vx3EM_PZ5H0LZO7xe_j9rCdXmvhr_PGJKsU26GyFkG9MvwX-L7wa_AwAA__8fLWzh), requiring automated vehicle companies to self-certify their vehicles as Level 4 autonomous. Tesla also trails Avride (317 vehicles) and Nuro (47). The 42-vehicle total badly undercuts Elon Musk's earlier promise of [500 Austin robotaxis](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L-OhCAQx_GnwQ4zgH-woLjGbq-90qCMSoKwgdl1957-4r7CdZNM8skv35_bdLM--Lh92wMNvdY0RTxLQCLMU6GHw0glY1ke6DZ7YE8p-m2SIDsOLVcwOevDe2oqZ2Zwg6jQiF6DUHroVbWbptEaQIluRdco1Qndd32ziGWwrQOtK28uDFoFQoBsZd1LYed2XhWinTscWAPoPKVc046EL1vW8E5PzPWSjiqYnehemPpicmRyPM-zXuK8XE8mx8tmcoT2ujWTI2EJluc0J7Ivz9eASPyj8hSRE0baefG_yNPKT_s-UuHrJ1HhGZ9oQ73TEaps3P30IfjS9ayB7bA-fAbR_zI-jfwLAAD__wPGhyo) by the end of 2025. Texas is now one of the country's most active AV markets, with 10 companies authorized statewide.
## 8 Students Rescued from Texas Coaster
Eight HISD students were [stranded 100 feet up](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO5CAQRL8GZ4ygjbEJCC5xtpdeaLWh8aBlzAp6xrt_f5r7hYsqKKlU7_352D4wl3wev_FBnr9T3U66eiFmalvnZ6STe6MenhQPfNDM9czHBgqsVJMc1RYxl5_NDNHvKjo9kNfzovS4uHkc7n4Z57SH3ZJJ0Rm0mnQyCUaYXAI1myH795iaRqW1ggluM2jcpz2NRLhbcsIoiplru_GdmL6xp_JTX9RuoT6G4u_MX12MvwSsAtbrum6f9_p8lwJWbJxDIQHrm0vAWmrA8s78InnWS7YcqXXZ-Rk-ZT3lgeVFnespWy2FWqjYmZqAFZZJktFuCWGRE2qUxiqSC1iSIZBD5yxO2g7Nx68rl5K7nYVRxwNz-XeW_0_xy8PfAAAA__9QQI_U) on Galveston's Iron Shark roller coaster Thursday after the ride malfunctioned mid-ascent, leaving them tilted skyward in the sun. Galveston firefighters used a tower truck ladder to harness and lower the students one at a time, the [rescue stretching four hours](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdEbDGHBcuNiGLttuiQweiCWDLXsSkr9f5f3Cq690dc75d5_vLsRw7n_dQZbfW5pPumokZipz5aenk2uhuj7J7-4gzekM-4yAo4RBKpi9C_Ez9423C3jTNWQ7fYNO3YxWzcN6gJvyowGjV-wcmM30pjdkEMZ10EMT7PcMBgVdBzhgq7Fzy7BsisgtIxnRA_nAqbT8IKa3q1v8pBeVdk1HE-2DOVeh_gicBE7XdbXnsvrt-s4Cp6-PwCmm1UWBU6aUI0kuLmfysqQYqcg1ucpU5O7iiyqns8ocydVnIZkDFYFTD2i0UQKnplifrxBjqKMWPeyHC_EHhn-X8GXxfwAAAP__7lGGTw) before all eight reached the ground. | Healey Hides with Friday Night Speech Healey's Mass Dems Speech Avoids Issues, Focus on Rhetoric as Reported
BOSTON, MA - Governor Maura Healey delivered her Massachusetts Democratic Convention speech at 8:30 p.m. Friday night; the classic time politicians bury bad news.
As expected, the address lacked substance, sidestepping her lack of successes.
"Hiding from the voters with an 8:30 p.m. Friday night speech is laughable, especially for an incumbent Governor," said Haley Jones, Executive Director of the Massachusetts Republican Party.
Jones continued, "She has been hiding from so many scandals and failures; this is just more of the same. I doubt most people even heard it. Everyone knows politicians dump things on Friday nights when they have nothing good to show."
"With a speech full of so much fear, anger, and negativity from Healey, Massachusetts deserves a new, kind Governor. Someone focused on solving problems, not political posturing," she concluded.

name: Erin Conway
subject: My last deadline
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic National Committee, www
body:
---
Derek — it’s Erin Conway, the DNC’s Grassroots Fundraising Director. **I’m reaching out because, after eight years, tomorrow will be my last end-of-month deadline here at the DNC.** This work isn’t easy, but I wanted to share with you the reasons I’ve stayed for so many years: **The people.** Over the last eight years, I’ve seen a lot of changes at the DNC. In this field, change is our one constant, and people come and go with election cycles. name: Douglas Carswell
subject: A Mississippi Mystery
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/usnationaldebt-12853493?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| _**If you're not in front of our Saturday email, you're behind.**_
---
| Dear Friend,
**Car tags in Mississippi typically cost between $300 and $700 a year. In the first year of ownership, the bill often runs higher still - somewhere between $800 and $1,500.** Cross the state line into Arkansas or Alabama, and the same car tag will cost you about half as much.

Put aside, for a moment, what this says about car tags. What does it say about Mississippi politics?
This is a state where voters consistently elect conservative leaders at every level of government. And yet we still end up with some of the highest car tag costs in the country.

**Sadly, it is not just car tags where Mississippi seems to end up with rather less than the full-flavor conservatism voters thought they were buying.**
---
| [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/p1JK6dHSR2S?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)
---
_Click on the image to see if your local lawmaker is conservative!_
| Mississippians elect lawmakers in the expectation that they will be conservative. It is why both the House and the Senate have solidly conservative majorities. But when it comes to the laws those majorities actually pass, things are not always as conservative as you might expect.

**Listening to some Republicans in the Senate kill the school choice bill in 84 seconds, you could be forgiven for thinking you were watching progressive lawmakers in Massachusetts or Minnesota.**

Under the Mississippi constitution, you - the voter - are entitled to a direct say through the ballot initiative. Due to changes in the number of congressional districts, the old trigger mechanism was ruled defunct. Rather than restore it - which is what you would expect from conservatives who trust the people - our Senate leadership has consistently killed every effort to bring it back.

There have, of course, been some important wins. Labor deregulation in 2021. Flat tax reform in 2022, thanks to Speaker Gunn, which paved the way for the income tax elimination law passed in 2025. This session, too, saw an important step toward repealing red tape in healthcare — the certificate of need law, an intentionally protectionist relic.

But part of the problem is this. **With local media struggling, politicians know that no one is really holding them to account for what they actually do. So long as they turn up at the right events and post the right photos on social media — hunting trips, club suppers— they get assumed to be conservative.** Even when they vote rather more like a Kamala Harris Democrat.
---
|
---
_Who voted conservative?_
| **The good news is that there is now a tool that lets you see how your lawmakers actually voted.**

The Mississippi Freedom Index has just launched. At [**MississippiFreedom.com**](https://us.list-manage.com/AfAecRrcIXh?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3), you can see how your local representative voted on the key issues of this session. You will notice that there are only two key bills tracked — because, frankly, this session only produced two clearly conservative measures. And even then, a large chunk of the Republican caucus failed to support them.

Take a look. You can also pull up campaign finance reports for each lawmaker, so you can see who is supporting them.

Like the cost of car tags, one of the great Mississippi mysteries is why a state that votes so consistently conservative so seldom sees fully conservative policy.

It is also important to recognise those genuinely principled leaders in our state — like Speaker Jason White - who have shown real conservative leadership when it counted.

The first step in getting more of them, and fewer of the Kamala kind, is knowing the difference. [**MississippiFreedom.com**](https://us.list-manage.com/NhS1QTQAuAA?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) is how you find out.
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://us.list-manage.com/a8f_5PT15GC?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3 "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO
Mississippi Center for Public Policy

You will notice that there are only two key bills tracked — because, frankly, this session only produced two clearly conservative measures. And even then, a large chunk of the Republican caucus failed to support them. Take a look. You can also pull up campaign finance reports for each lawmaker, so you can see who is supporting them. Like the cost of car tags, one of the great Mississippi mysteries is why a state that votes so consistently conservative so seldom sees fully conservative policy. It is also important to recognise those genuinely principled leaders in our state — like Speaker Jason White - who have shown real conservative leadership when it counted. The first step in getting more of them, and fewer of the Kamala kind, is knowing the difference. is how you find out. | "Forward this email to a friend!" | | Warm regards, Douglas Carswell President & CEO Mississippi Center for Public Policy | | |

| | Peter,

My name is Katie Britt, and if it’s alright with you, I’d like to share a little about who I am. **I’m not part of the D.C. cocktail circuit, and I never will be._That’s just not who I am._**

In 2022, I was elected to represent the great state of Alabama in the United States Senate. I became the first woman in Alabama’s history to hold this seat—but that’s not why I ran.

I ran because I’m a _**mom**_ , a _**wife**_ , and a _**conservative**_ who’s fed up with the direction this country is heading. I came to Washington to fight for our families, to protect our values, and to bring some Alabama backbone to a broken system.

I didn’t come here to make friends with the political elite. I came here to stand up for the people who don’t have a voice in the room—and I’m not backing down.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q2?refcode=x_260530_everytownendorsement_EOM2_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q2?refcode=x_260530_everytownendorsement_EOM2_act]
When I first saw this endorsement, I needed to take a moment.
Everytown for Gun Safety Action Fund is an organization that fights to protect our families from preventable violence, and I am one of only two congressional candidates in Michigan to receive their endorsement.
This means a lot to me, not only as a mom of three, but as a former sexual assault and child abuse prosecutor, I spent years advocating for victims of violence and working to end the entirely preventable deaths that occur in this country of gun violence and unsafe storage. I am looking forward to continuing that work in the U.S. House.
If this resonates with you, I’m asking you personally: will you contribute $5 today to help us get our message out, compete with the MAGA machine, and reach the voters who will decide this race? → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q2?refcode=x_260530_everytownendorsement_EOM2_act&amount=5]
CHIP $5 IN TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q2?refcode=x_260530_everytownendorsement_EOM2_act&amount=5]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q2?refcode=x_260530_everytownendorsement_EOM2_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q2?refcode=x_260530_everytownendorsement_EOM2_act]
I know better than anyone else in this race that families here want the same thing: safe communities and leaders willing to put people first.
Parents should not have to fear for their children’s safety at school, at the grocery store, at church, or in their own neighborhoods. But across the country, families are living with that fear while D.C. fails to act.
This election is about the kind of leadership we choose and whether we will fight for safer communities and responsible action. That’s why this endorsement means so much to me.

The only thing that counters AIPAC’s spending is people-powered money —

body:
Trump wants to build a monument dedicated entirely to himself — the Arc de Trump — which would block the view from Lincoln Memorial to the Arlington National Cemetery and literally put the graves of our honored dead in his shadow.
#
During Trump’s first term, we organized and helped stop his repeated efforts to hold a military parade.
Last year we did the same around his birthday parade. Despite our opposition and that of millions of other Americans, Trump went through with it. Far from the national celebration Trump claimed, it was an international embarrassment.
But now, we’ve got another chance to stop him. Trump wants to build a monument dedicated entirely to himself — the Arc de Trump — which would block the view from Lincoln Memorial to the Arlington National Cemetery and literally put the graves of our honored dead in his shadow.
He’s doing it while he guts the VA and hamstrings care for all Veterans, while American Troops are in harm’s way because of his leadership, with gas prices out of control and January 6th insurrectionists about to get payouts from a $1.8 billion fund.
This is absolutely ridiculous, and we’re not going to sit around and let it happen.
Veterans are suing to stop Trump’s arch already, and Democrats have introduced legislation to block construction altogether. If that legislation is going to pass, it’ll be the voices of Veterans who make it possible.
And for that, we need your help.
[**Sign our petition: Tell Congress to block the Arc de Trump. Arlington is a sacred space, and the fallen should never be overshadowed by a failed president with dictatorial aims.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/2600506_ARC_DE_TRUMP_CONGRESS/?source=em260530-1-120&refcode2=35183.3013755.YOQfAg&akid=35183%2E3013755%2EYOQfAg)

---
_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched.
