An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. Peter, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture. But moments like this don't sustain themselves. If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple. We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. If you've already supported Turning Point USA in the past, thank you for carrying this movement forward every single day. If you haven't yet, I'm asking you to step in now. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

| Friend,

Direct from the White House, my friend President Trump said:

**“JIM JORDAN IS A VERY GOOD FRIEND, FIGHTER, AND WINNER... HE WILL _NEVER_ LET YOU DOWN”**

[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkEtutDAQhE9jdiA_eC68mF-I3fyKokizRMbdHpxgQKbJXD9yMjlAtvVVl7rqdh2vxi9-vf83AXUkN8ZjBB_RkotboBkfsyect_PAUXJZ57zKFU8ukYEGC0bYDLVoWi7Kpq3abNa8MY6XXdlZ1TmHUDWda1ECtK6asDGZ1ymKV4oLpXhVF1NXl9Bx2zic2lI5VnKzYKQi4n5Oi7dmJXN8uC1aLOwWskXPRPvB1IXJgcnhQHtGLB5-jQjJweRAaEL-vkUwK5MDYCtAct5NAnESKt2p4aQwWhN24-8rU_3PW1IwWScSEPwZmOoxGL88RbJM9a9vg8x_SzzBsZ3RYoK38d9Ts9tKuBJT_cslixr2h18Wf9QNK_k9hX63ob8u_6nlVwAAAP__TauPGQ)

**But I’ve got the receipts to back it up**. I’ve been sued. I’ve been spied on. My phone records were seized. And the Left only attacks me, because I fight for YOU.

_**✅Grow our economy

**If 2% more Republicans show up, we can EASILY erase the Democrats’ 2-point lead. This is a problem we can absolutely fix.**

_So, we are going zip code by zip code in our voter file to determine where we need more participation._

body:
Growing up, this kid learned that through hard work, he could do anything he set his mind to.
#

Growing up, this kid learned that through hard work, he could do anything he set his mind to.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-may26.8vozgy&refcode=em260530-1-180-90&t=1&akid=6478%2E6688874%2EKG0Lk_)
At the age of 23, he became a United States naval aviator. He deployed twice on the U.S.S. Midway and flew 39 combat missions in Operation Desert Storm.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-may26.8vozgy&refcode=em260530-1-180-90&t=2&akid=6478%2E6688874%2EKG0Lk_)
Then, at the age of 32, he was selected as an astronaut (with his twin brother, Scott!). He flew his first of four missions into space in 2001 aboard Space Shuttle Endeavour. He spent more than 50 days in space and has lived on the International Space Station.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-may26.8vozgy&refcode=em260530-1-180-90&t=3&akid=6478%2E6688874%2EKG0Lk_)
In 2011, Mark's wife, former Congresswoman Gabby Giffords, was shot in Tucson during an event where she was meeting with her constituents. Mark retired from the Navy and NASA, and his mission turned from service to his country to caring for his wife. But Gabby's service in Congress, using policy to improve people's lives, stuck with him.
So, in 2020, Mark took on his next mission — running for U.S. Senate in Arizona — and won.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-may26.8vozgy&refcode=em260530-1-180-90&t=4&akid=6478%2E6688874%2EKG0Lk_)
Then, in 2022, he had to turn around and run for a full term in the Senate. And thanks to our incredible team, he won again.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-may26.8vozgy&refcode=em260530-1-180-90&t=5&akid=6478%2E6688874%2EKG0Lk_)
Now, Mark’s in yet another important position. As Vice Chair of the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee, it’s on Mark to find a way to defend every incumbent Democrat in the Senate. And, to win back our majority, he’s got to take four seats back from the GOP, too.
Alongside everything else Mark’s gone through over the past several months, it’s a tall task. But if anybody can do it, it’s him — and he needs your help.
[**Can you make a $5 contribution as we approach a critical end-of-month deadline? Mark can’t do this alone.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-may26.8vozgy&refcode=em260530-1-180-90&t=6&akid=6478%2E6688874%2EKG0Lk_)

* * *
Dear Friend, My name is Kimberly Bretches. I'm a wife and a mother of four young children. And I'm writing to you today because I am out of options and I am terrified. I'll be honest, asking strangers for help doesn't come naturally to me. But neither does the idea of my husband spending the rest of his life in prison for doing his job — so here I am. Chance is a police officer in Austin, Texas. He is, without question, the best man I know. He has spent his career keeping dangerous people off the streets, protecting a city that doesn't always make it easy to do so, and coming home every night to a family that needs him. His supervisors have praised him for his professionalism, for his instincts, for his dedication. He is exactly the kind of officer you want showing up when things go wrong. | By every measure, Chance did everything right. He used department-approved tools, following his training, to protect his fellow officers and the people of Austin.
---
And in May of 2020, things went very wrong in Austin. For three consecutive days, our city was under siege. subject: All eyes are on Texas, Peter.
body:
Help defeat Abbott and Ken Paxton in November.
The Texas Senate race is officially set, Peter.
**Texas Republicans are heading into November with Greg Abbott and Ken Paxton.**
And now we’re moving into the next phase of this fight with one mission in mind — **ending the era of corruption and negligence Texans have been living under for _far too long._**
Abbott and Paxton have built their careers on putting their mega donors and political games first and Texas families last. And after years of their leadership, we have nothing to show for it.
Right now, Texan families are suffering with higher costs. Public schools are severely underfunded. We have a healthcare crisis that has millions of Texas children uninsured. And a government that’s more concerned with holding power than solving problems.
**That’s why I am building something different. Because Texans deserve better, and we know it’s going to take a strong, united front to finally turn the page in Texas.**
All eyes are on Texas right now, Peter. We have six months to reach voters in every corner of this state, build the strongest Democratic ticket Texas has seen in decades, _and win._

This is the game that matters most. I am honored to be in it — and I would be humbled to have you as my teammate in this fight.

| | | |
---
| | | Hi Peter, My name is Jay Feely. I'm a husband, a father of four, a retired NFL player, sports broadcaster, and a proud Arizona conservative -- and **I'm running for Congress in Arizona's 1st District.**

I'll tell you more about my story in a moment. But first, I need you to understand what's at stake in this race -- because it goes far beyond Arizona.

**AZ-1 is one of the most targeted House seats in the country in 2026.**

Democrats and their allied super PACs already have this race circled. If they flip this seat, they have a path to reclaiming the House majority -- and reversing everything we've fought to build.

That is why President Trump and Republican House Leadership have endorsed me in this race, [_**and why I'm writing to you today asking for your support.**_](https://trk.win.jayfeelyforcongress._49xfW7tv9rrSBNASA)
---
[ **JOIN JAY 'S TEAM!** ](https://trk.win.jayfeelyforcongress._E8tQJCrPlguagIerA)
---
Now -- let me tell you who I am and why I believe God has called me to this fight.I grew up in a middle-class family in Florida, and was taught from a young age that **our blessings aren't meant to be hoarded -- they're meant to be poured out for others.** That truth has shaped every chapter of my life. I earned a scholarship to the University of Michigan, won a National Championship in 1997, and went on to play fourteen years in the NFL.I wasn't the biggest or the fastest player on the field. But I was elected team captain on three different teams because my teammates trusted me to lead with integrity and fight for what was right.
---
[](https://trk.win.jayfeelyforcongress.)
---
When the NFL went into lockout negotiations, my fellow players sent me to Washington to sit across the table from ownership at the Federal mediation office. **I didn't back down then. I won't back down in Congress either.** After football, I spent ten years as an NFL analyst for CBS, earning five Emmy Awards along the way. But the work I'm most proud of has nothing to do with broadcast booths or trophies.My wife Rebecca and I fell in love with Arizona fifteen years ago when I signed with the Cardinals. We loved it so much we decided it was the perfect place to raise our family -- and we've been putting down roots here ever since. We founded the Feely Family Foundation to invest in youth and education. I served on the Gilbert Christian School Board. I started the first girls' soccer program at Gilbert Christian High School, coached our daughter Lexi's team to a state championship, and was named Arizona State Coach of the Year.
---
[](https://trk.win.jayfeelyforcongress.)
---
**This is home. These are our people. And I am not going to stand by and watch Washington fail them.**
---
[ **JOIN JAY 'S TEAM!** ](https://trk.win.jayfeelyforcongress.-EUmdLPv97nhtltkS5OQQ)
---
**_The border crisis is real_** , and it has impacted communities like ours every single day -- straining our schools, our hospitals, our law enforcement, and our neighborhoods.Our **_small business owners_** are being crushed by taxes and federal regulations that punish hard work and reward dependency. And Washington has been kicking these problems down the road for decades while the people who sent them there are left to deal with the wreckage.I have spent my life preparing for moments that matter. **This is one of those moments.** I believe God has blessed me with a platform, a voice, and a set of experiences that can make a real difference in Congress. I believe my kids -- and yours -- deserve a representative who will fight for them with everything he has. And I believe that each of us has to decide whether we're going to watch from the sidelines or get in the game when it counts. **_This is when it counts._** I am asking you -- humbly and sincerely -- to stand with me today. [_**A gift of $10, $25, $50 or more goes directly into this fight. This race is going to be one of the most expensive House contests in the country. Every dollar we raise is a signal that we are organized, serious, and ready to win in AZ-1.**_](https://trk.win.jayfeelyforcongress._j6GRH-dUQ)
---
[ **JOIN JAY 'S TEAM!** ](https://trk.win.jayfeelyforcongress.-8nj3qIaQ9Udw)
---
I have never walked away from a hard fight in my life. Not on the field. Not in the locker room. Not at the negotiating table in Washington.**But I can't win this one without you...** AZ-1 is the race that determines who controls the House. The Democrats know it. The liberal super PACs know it. And now you know it too. God has put me in this moment for a reason. I believe that with everything I have. And I believe He puts the right people in front of us at the right time -- which is why I'm asking you, right now, to be part of this. _**[A gift of $10, $25, $50 or more today helps us build the organization this race demands and sends a message that we're not going to roll over.](https://trk.win.jayfeelyforcongress._iBv0KU-oyNsw)**_This is the game that matters most. I am honored to be in it -- and I would be humbled to have you as my teammate in this fight.
---
[ **JOIN JAY 'S TEAM!** ](https://trk.win.jayfeelyforcongress.-HLvQ)
---
| | | For faith, family, and Arizona --
---
[](https://trk.win.jayfeelyforcongress.-_xpz6r9VmFjg)
---
Jay Feely
Republican, AZ-1
---
P.S. -- I spent fourteen years competing at the highest level in professional sports. I know what it takes to win a tough game. But the work I'm most proud of has nothing to do with broadcast booths or trophies.My wife Rebecca and I fell in love with Arizona fifteen years ago when I signed with the Cardinals. We loved it so much we decided it was the perfect place to raise our family -- and we've been putting down roots here ever since. We founded the Feely Family Foundation to invest in youth and education. I served on the Gilbert Christian School Board. I started the first girls' soccer program at Gilbert Christian High School, coached our daughter Lexi's team to a state championship, and was named Arizona State Coach of the Year. This is home. These are our people. And I am not going to stand by and watch Washington fail them. The border crisis is real , and it has impacted communities like ours every single day -- straining our schools, our hospitals, our law enforcement, and our neighborhoods.Our small business owners are being crushed by taxes and federal regulations that punish hard work and reward dependency. And Washington has been kicking these problems down the road for decades while the people who sent them there are left to deal with the wreckage.I have spent my life preparing for moments that matter. This is one of those moments. I believe God has blessed me with a platform, a voice, and a set of experiences that can make a real difference in Congress. I believe my kids -- and yours -- deserve a representative who will fight for them with everything he has. And I believe that each of us has to decide whether we're going to watch from the sidelines or get in the game when it counts. This is when it counts. I am asking you -- humbly and sincerely -- to stand with me today. I have never walked away from a hard fight in my life. Not on the field. Not in the locker room. Not at the negotiating table in Washington.But I can't win this one without you... AZ-1 is the race that determines who controls the House. The Democrats know it. The liberal super PACs know it. And now you know it too. God has put me in this moment for a reason. I believe that with everything I have. And I believe He puts the right people in front of us at the right time -- which is why I'm asking you, right now, to be part of this. is the game that matters most. I am honored to be in it -- and I would be humbled to have you as my teammate in this fight. | | | For faith, family, and Arizona -- Jay Feely Republican, AZ-1 P.S. -- I spent fourteen years competing at the highest level in professional sports. I know what it takes to win a tough game. But every winning team needs people behind them who believe in the mission. | | | ---|--- | | | Paid for by Feely for Congress | | |

Team, **June is going to be one of the most important months in this fight for our democracy.** Republicans in Tennessee thought they could gut voting rights in a three-day special session and get away with it. They were wrong. **And we're not alone.** In Alabama, a federal court just blocked the Republicans' discriminatory map (again). In South Carolina, the legal fight is still very much alive. **The South is where this battle is taking place, and Tennessee is at its center.** The momentum is building. More voices are joining the fight. And what we do in the coming months could shape the future of our state for years to come. The fight intensifies in June. More organizing. More pressure. More critical moments that will shape whether Tennessee Democrats go into November with the resources needed to win. body:
Money taken from working family paychecks and funneled into activism. The swamp killed DOGE. I'm bringing it back.

| | | | | [|
---](https://ericburlisonforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b6500a115da3c4344522b1e48&id=c47b7b7f4d&e=5f9dc01b8c)
| | Peter ,
**When I go back home to MO-07, the small talk is about DOGE.** Not the weather. Not the Cardinals. DOGE.People at the gas station, at the diner, and at church on Sunday. They walk up and tell me the same thing. They were excited. For the first time in a long time, somebody in Washington actually believed what they believe. Somebody was opening the books. Asking the questions nobody was supposed to ask. Auditing the agencies that had spent decades operating without a single hard look.That was a once-in-a-generation moment. And the swamp killed it.**Here's what they did not want you to see.** A lot of what DOGE was uncovering was not just inefficient spending. It was evil. I mean that word.Money taken out of working family paychecks - yours, mine, the guy who fixed my truck last month - and funneled into projects those families would never, in a million years, voluntarily pay for. Activism dressed up with a science label. Ideology with a federal grant number stamped on it. Political agendas being funded by people who would be furious if they knew where their tax dollars were actually going.That's not a budgeting problem. That's a theft problem. The federal government has been quietly converting paychecks into activism for decades, and DOGE was about to put the whole operation on the front page.So they killed it.**Think about who that tells you was running scared.** The people who run the agencies. The people who write the grants. The people who decide which "researchers" get funded and which ones don't. They were not upset that DOGE found waste. They were upset that DOGE was about to make the public understand the racket.And when the swamp gets nervous, it has tools. The press. The lobbyists. The career bureaucrats who outlast every administration. They piled on, they smeared the work, and they buried it.But they cannot bury what people already saw. The American people watched DOGE pull back the curtain. They liked what they saw. And they are not going to forget it.**My position is simple.** We are not paying for fake science anymore.If your institution takes federal money and produces activism with a science label, your funding is on the chopping block. If your agency resisted efficiency reviews because you did not want anyone seeing where the money went, you do not get a budget increase next year. You get a hearing.And I am not letting DOGE stay dead. I am pushing to bring it back. Not as a temporary commission that the swamp can kill again, but as a permanent standing function of Congress. The work was underway. The receipts were being pulled. We know where the waste is, and we know who was profiting from it. The job just needs finishing.**But here's the truth about how Washington works.** The people who killed DOGE the first time are already lining up to kill it again. They have donors. They have lobbyists. They have the candidates they want to replace people like me with. People who will look the other way.All I have is you.**I am not going to stop fighting. Patriot,
In 2023, our team conducted our first domestic rescue in California.
**A 12-year-old girl.** _Trafficked. Drugged. Raped. Held for 45 days in a homeless encampment under a bridge._
_**Our operators physically extracted her.** _
What it takes to be that team is what most people never see. The training. The intelligence work. The willingness to walk into a homeless encampment under a bridge knowing exactly what you might find and what you might have to do to bring a child out alive. The capacity to stay steady when the place you are going to is the worst place a 12-year-old has ever been.
**And underneath all of it, faith.** Our operators are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure before they ever set foot on a mission – because the work breaks anyone who walks into it without something stronger than their own will to fall back on. **We are the hands and feet of Jesus Christ in the field, and we have been since the day this organization started.** That is not a slogan. It is the load-bearing piece of how a team walks under that bridge and walks back out with a 12-year-old girl alive.
Thanks to God and the work of our operators, she made it home. Her family will never be the same. Neither will our team.
She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – _the next child is already missing._
**This is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments. Today, I write to you as the Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity.**

**We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Fast forward, and today we are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work most organizations cannot.**
In the last 90 days alone, our team has operated across three continents – efforts which entailed:
**✅ Eight American families extracted **from Mexico in February.

**✅ 33 American families and 155 additional Americans** assisted across Israel, Egypt, and Jordan in March.

**✅ 100,000+ meals distributed to individuals in desperate need in Haiti**.

**✅ Three more young teenage children rescued from trafficking situations** in Virginia and West Texas this January.
The work goes back further. **64 evacuated from Ukraine** during active combat in 2022. **58 Christians rescued from persecution** across Asia-Pacific and granted asylum.
For five years we have done all of this from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But the demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way.
**So we've just launched an intensive, nationwide capital campaign for the Heroes for Humanity National Training Center – a permanent home for the mission, right here in our home state of Texas.**
**The Training Center is a permanent facility built around the three pillars of our mission – precision personnel rescues, humanitarian and medical aid, and evangelism.** Standardized certification for every operator we put in the field. Medical and trauma training for austere and hostile environments. An OSINT and intelligence hub for ongoing mission planning. And the capacity to train the next generation of operators – at scale, under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure – for as long as the mission lasts.
**Total goal:** $1,000,000 by October.
**First milestone:** $100,000.

clean_body: Every flag supports Veterans for Congress and helps honor the country they fought for. | Fellow American, This Independence Day, House Republicans are launching a nationwide mission to place 50,000 American flags into the hands of proud patriots across the country. But this effort is about far more than flags. Every single flag claimed helps support Veterans for Congress, brave Americans who served this nation in uniform and are now stepping forward once again to defend it in Washington. From small towns to major cities, we want the Stars and Stripes flying proudly in every corner of America before July 4th arrives. And with America 's 250th birthday right around the corner, this mission carries even greater meaning. These flags represent sacrifice. They represent freedom. They represent the people who built this country and the heroes who protected it. We 're running out of time to complete distribution before July 4th, and we're asking patriots like you to help us finish the mission strong. Please step up today, support Veterans for Congress, and claim your American flag before supplies run out. # [No more dress rehearsals](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=199775339&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk5Nzc1MzM5LCJpYXQiOjE3ODAxNTM1NzIsImV4cCI6MTc4Mjc0NTU3MiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.MJNzILru3TuX59JU8sFeEUAfyMkMQc9jdU8opSLntcI)
### One of the last end-of-month deadlines before the primary is here
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| May 30
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..HMjLugZHNFZa8lHH3HIskYK3q1Rq3KNLXMO6oODR1rg?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/no-more-dress-rehearsals?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Friends,
August 4 is on my mind a lot these days.
That's primary day. It's when Michiganders will decide which Democrat takes on Mike Rogers and his MAGA allies in November.
And it's coming fast.
When I think about that, I know this: **We are coming up on one of the last end-of-month deadlines before the primary, and this one really matters.**
**[Tomorrow at midnight is a big one. We have a major fundraising goal of $350,000, and we need to hit it.](https://substack.com/redirect/579af71a-f927-464e-85e6-2abbe53396ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Because this is no longer the part of the campaign where things are far away.
There are no more dress rehearsals.
Every dollar that comes in before midnight tomorrow does something real between now and primary day. It helps put organizers on the ground in Macomb County, Saginaw, Detroit, and communities all across the state. It funds the phone-banking and conversations with voters that actually turn _support for Haley into votes for Haley_. It helps us reach Michiganders in every corner of the state - including the people and places too often overlooked.
And I want to say this plainly because I've said versions of it before, and I want to make sure you hear me:
I am not building this campaign on viral moments. I'm building it the Michigan way - one shift, one conversation, one day of hustle at a time.
This campaign is powered by real people.
Not MAGA billionaires. Not giant personal fortunes. Not a celebrity endorsement.
Working people who actually give a damn about this state.
I'm the only person in this race who is not a millionaire. **[And that's why I appreciate every single person who chips in $5, $10, or whatever they can to help power this campaign.](https://substack.com/redirect/579af71a-f927-464e-85e6-2abbe53396ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
That has always mattered to me, and it matters even more now.
Because what we are building here is real.
Rooted in Michigan.
That is what your support fuels. And there is no version of this campaign that wins without it.
So if you're in a position to chip in before this end-of-month deadline tomorrow night, I would be truly grateful. **[Whatever you can do helps fuel the work that gets us to primary day and helps keep Michigan blue.](https://substack.com/redirect/579af71a-f927-464e-85e6-2abbe53396ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/579af71a-f927-464e-85e6-2abbe53396ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I'm grateful you're with me.
More soon.
With grit and gratitude,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

My wife loves to sew. It is the hobby she comes back to when the week has worn her out -- fabric spread across the table, the hum of the machine, something taking shape under her hands. So when she told me the other night about the man who invented the first sewing machine and then decided not to give it to the world, I listened the way you listen to someone who knows her subject. The story stuck with me, and the more I looked into it, the more I thought other people should hear it too.
In the early 1830s, a New York mechanic named Walter Hunt built something that should have made him rich. It was a small machine with two needles that could sew a lockstitch -- clean, fast, and tireless. It was, in every meaningful sense, the first practical sewing machine.
He never patented it.
The reason was his fifteen-year-old daughter, Caroline. When she understood what her father had built, she pleaded with him not to bring it to market. Thousands of seamstresses, she argued, would lose the only work they had. These were women who hunched over fabric by candlelight for pennies a day, ruining their eyes and their backs to feed their families. A machine that could outwork them would take the bread out of their hands.
Hunt listened. He set the invention aside and walked away from a fortune. In 1846, a man named Elias Howe patented something very similar. A few years later, Isaac Singer turned the same idea into one of the most successful businesses of the nineteenth century.
Hunt was not the only one to hesitate. Across the Atlantic, the French tailor Barthelemy Thimonnier had been bolder. He patented a sewing machine in 1830 and opened a Paris workshop with eighty of them, stitching uniforms for the French army. In 1831, a mob of two hundred tailors stormed the building and smashed every machine. Thimonnier escaped with his life. He died bankrupt in England.
The fear that animated Caroline Hunt and the Paris tailors was real and rational. They could see, plainly, that one machine could do the work of many hands. What they could not see was everything else that would come next.
Within a few decades of Howe's patent, the American garment industry did not shrink. It exploded. Ready-made clothing production grew from forty million dollars in 1850 to seventy million by 1870. By the Civil War, sewing machines were turning out uniforms by the trainload. Factories sprang up, then department stores, then mail-order catalogs. Clothing became affordable for ordinary people for the first time in human history. The number of people employed in making clothes did not collapse. It grew, and kept growing, for the next hundred years.
This is the part Caroline could not have imagined, and it is the part the rioting tailors could not have imagined either. Human beings do not simply absorb a new tool and shed the jobs it touches. We invent new things to do with it. We invent new things, period. A cheaper shirt creates a buyer who never could afford one. A faster stitch frees a designer to try something that would have been ruinous before. Demand expands to fill the space that productivity opens up, and the ingenuity of ordinary working people fills it with work no one had thought to ask for yet.
That is the lesson Caroline missed, and it is the one her father missed when he listened to her. Their compassion was admirable. Their economics was wrong. The seamstresses they wanted to protect were not better off in the world without the sewing machine. They were poorer, sicker, and locked into worse work. The machine, when it finally came, did not erase them. It lifted the whole industry up around them.
The fear of change is honest. It is rooted in the visible thing in front of you -- the needle, the job, the wage. But it is almost always blind to the cloth on the other side of the machine, to the markets that don't exist yet, to the work that human imagination has not yet invented.
I think about the Hunts every time someone tells me artificial intelligence will end work as we know it. Maybe some jobs will go. Some always do. But if history has any lesson to teach us, it is that we have stood at this loom before. We have looked at a new machine and seen only what it would take away. And every time, human ingenuity has stitched something larger than we could imagine on the other side.

We won’t
beat around the bush. The Supreme Court is corrupt.

And here’s a prime example: Justice Clarence Thomas has accepted roughly
$4 million in gifts since 2004 — and disclosed almost none of it.^1

We wish we were joking. Private jet flights. Yacht vacations. Luxury
resorts. Real estate deals benefiting his family. Even private school
tuition payments for his grandnephew.

And while accepting these gifts, Thomas repeatedly ruled on cases
benefiting the same right-wing political movement backed by some of his
biggest benefactors — Republican billionaire Harlan Crow and Federalist
Society power broker Leonard Leo.^2

We’re talking about decisions gutting voting rights, weakening campaign
finance laws, shielding dark money donors, and siding with corporations
over workers.

That’s the real scandal here: the same wealthy operatives funding luxury
lifestyles for Supreme Court justices are also helping shape the laws and
rulings that protect their own power.

This is exactly what happens when the most powerful court in the country
has no enforceable ethics code, no meaningful accountability, and justices
who believe they can police themselves.

Demand Justice PAC is fighting for binding ethics rules, mandatory
disclosure requirements, term limits, and structural reform to restore a
Court that works for the American people — not billionaire donors and
right-wing insiders.

body:
We hit our goal, and now it's time to double down
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260530-2862)
Peter,
Wow. Yesterday, you all showed up for us—for me, my team, and for our volunteers.
We closed our $20,000 gap, and I couldn't have done it without our incredible grassroots network. **I’m so grateful.**
Today and tomorrow, we have so much more work to do, and it’s the last day to meet our end-of-month fundraising deadline. Our volunteers, our team, the community we’ve built; none of us are slowing down.
We’ve heard a lot about yard signs this week [**(if you know, you know)**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13447?t=1&akid=2862%2E105371%2EbrHcuc)**.** Contributions like yours are what make it possible for us to match their near infinite demand.
That’s why I’m asking for you all to double down, because my team needs the resources to harness the energy we’re seeing from volunteers all over the state.
**Turning our $20,000 into $40,000 would make a world of difference in my campaign—and small-dollar donations are what's gotten us this far.**
_And it’s what will take us past the finish line._
Tom Tiffany is already running his race against me, and I need the resources to show Wisconsin that we’re serious about winning.
Help us show Wisconsin what a people-powered campaign can look like.
**[Donate here today.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260530.sC9a20&refcode=em20260530-2862&t=2&akid=2862%2E105371%2EbrHcuc)**

With gratitude,
Fran

name: Protect Free Media via Our Revolution
subject: Tell Congress: Save public media, NOW!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

Trump will not rest until he and his billionaire cronies have COMPLETELY
taken over our media.

After Trump declared war on NPR and PBS, Congress voted to claw back $1.1
billion for public media. PBS stations have been forced to close their
doors. NPR is slashing jobs. The Corporation for Public Broadcasting had
no choice but to shut down entirely.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38711?source=email-20260530&t=1011&akid=10810%2E5885482%2EmegSdm ]Headline: Bloodbath brews at NPR due to federal cut - as 300 buyouts
offered

But then a judge ruled that Trump’s executive order to defund NPR and PBS
is unlawful and unenforceable. While the case is still working through the
courts, one thing is clear: this fight is NOT over. We can still save NPR
and PBS.

Now, some Republicans are saying they want to reverse the cuts to public
rural and tribal stations in the next budget bill, giving us a crucial
opportunity. But it’s going to take MASSIVE public pressure to save public
media before it’s too late.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38711?source=email-20260530&t=1012&akid=10810%2E5885482%2EmegSdm ]Tell Congress: Restore funding NOW to save our public media before it’s
too late.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38711?source=email-20260530&t=1013&akid=10810%2E5885482%2EmegSdm ]ADD YOUR NAME

Across the country, towns and tribes rely on public media as the ONLY
reliable bridge between isolated communities – like in Kotzebue, Alaska,
where new reports show that lifeline is hanging by a thread.

It isn’t just Alaska. In Montana, Oklahoma, New Mexico, and many states,
tribal and rural radio is the hub of emergency info, culture-sharing,
health alerts, and democratic engagement. And the MAJORITY of those
stations are warning they’ll be forced to go off the air unless Congress
reverses course, fast.

Now, some Republicans who voted for last year’s disastrous cuts are
publicly scrambling to reverse themselves. That means a last-ditch
Congressional fight is on.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38711?source=email-20260530&t=1014&akid=10810%2E5885482%2EmegSdm ]Headline: Some Republicans want to reverse GOP cuts to rural and tribal
radio stations

We know the MAGA movement’s long game: If they can destroy public media,
they can silence the last independent news – and hand FULL control over
what we hear, see, and read to billionaire moguls. They've already taken
over Twitter/X, Facebook, Amazon’s platforms, CBS, The Washington Post,
and now CNN is next.

But we ARE NOT powerless. Congress is debating its next budget RIGHT NOW
and can restore funding – IF we make enough noise. Last year, tens of
thousands of us took action, donated, rallied outside of NPR HQ, and made
it clear that we will not hand our media over to Trump and his billionaire
cronies. Now we need to do it again.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38711?source=email-20260530&t=1015&akid=10810%2E5885482%2EmegSdm ]Together, let’s force Congress to restore the federal funding public
media depends on. Add your name: Tell Congress to SAVE public media NOW!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/38711?source=email-20260530&t=1016&akid=10810%2E5885482%2EmegSdm ]ADD YOUR NAME

When we organize, we win.

Our Revolution

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.

These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.

That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here."

**P.S.** Friend, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture.

But moments like this don't sustain themselves.

If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple.

**We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. **

clean_body: | | | | | Friend, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. Friend, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture. But moments like this don't sustain themselves. If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple. We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. If you've already supported Turning Point USA in the past, thank you for carrying this movement forward every single day. If you haven't yet, I'm asking you to step in now. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The great heist movies end with the bad guys getting away with it. A clever crew on a crazy quest of enormous loot. The plot is outlandish, the shenanigans outrageous, and in the end, they disappear into the ether leaving the victims befuddled and the audience bemused.
Think of both the outstanding 1960 original and equally enjoyable 2001 remake of _Ocean 's Eleven_ or _The Italian Job_ or a personal favorite _Lock, Stock, and Two Smoking Barrels_. The bad guys are smart enough to vanish with their plunder.
Not long ago I **[wrote a piece here](https://substack.com/redirect/a0e099b3-8b91-47bc-8657-0cdc5afbb941?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** titled "Jill Biden Is the Most Evil Woman of the 21st Century". Self-explanatory, and I lay out a pretty convincing case. Jill Biden violated her marriage vows and destroyed a nation for personal gain: a $60million book deal, her degenerate son Hunter's finger doodles selling for $500,000 to anonymous bidders, her granddaughter's White House wedding extravaganza... Jill got the ultimate heist and all it took was puppeteering her senile husband.
She got away with it. All of it. But unlike the bad guys in the movies, **Jill won 't actually go away, and God almighty I hope it is her ultimate undoing,** for I loath Jill Biden the most evil woman of the 21st century.

What does one do when you think someone is having a stroke?

A vicious, conniving bitch trying to sell a book unworthy of my typing and your reading (but keep reading, I may have a book coming out).

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
MS NOW: ‘The largest investment ever’: DNC launches voter registration drive [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=053026_1&amount=30]
The 2025 elections showed us a valuable truth, folks: Voter participation is increasing in all the right ways.
Voter registration activity increased across the country. According to the team at National Voter Registration Day, New York recorded more registrations for their 2025 events than in 2024, and California saw similar increases. Earlier this fall it looked like voter participation was going to make a real jump, even in a so-called "off-year".
Then Election Day came. New Jersey had more voters turn out for a gubernatorial election than they had in 20 years. Crucial counties in Pennsylvania saw their highest turnout levels in almost 15 years. New York City reached a turnout percentage unseen in over five decades.
We can drive even higher levels of participation when voters understand the stakes and feel like their vote matters , just like it did last November. That's why our voter registration efforts are so important, and why we work on it all year long.
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. Will you step up with $30 or more today to help register 10 new voters? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=053026_1&amount=30]

The key is getting young people -- a major target of opponents of voting rights across the country -- to see the importance of voting now more than ever. Pundits in Virginia said they could have called the election results when they saw the first turnout numbers from the major college campus locations around the state. That's the kind of impact these young voters can have.
Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
The upcoming midterm election will determine whether our democracy stays mired in the darkness and conspiracy theories we hear every day or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and march forward to a better future.
New voter registration -- at a cost to us of just about $3 per new voter -- can be game-changing. Can you pitch in with $30 or however much you can to help us register a tidal wave of new voters ahead of this year's voter registration deadlines? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=053026_1&amount=30]

Once your portfolio crosses $1M, decisions start to interact — taxes, withdrawals, estate structure, and risk are all connected. At this level, coordinated advice may play an important role in retirement planning.

If you are evaluating advisors for a $1 million (or larger) portfolio, the consultation may provide more insight than marketing materials alone.

Use the seven questions below to help you assess how an advisor thinks, plans, and integrates across disciplines.

**1\. How do you integrate investment strategy with tax planning?**
Look for specifics: capital gains timing, tax-loss harvesting, and coordination with a CPA.

**2\. How do you design withdrawal strategies in different market conditions?**
Expect scenario modeling, not static projections.

**3\. When do Roth conversions make sense?**
Answers may include bracket analysis, IRMAA impact, and estate Considerations.

**4\. How do you handle concentrated positions?**
Listen for tax-aware diversification and risk management—not blanket advice.

**5\. How are you compensated, and how do you manage conflicts?**
Clarity matters more than structure alone. Ask how objectivity is maintained.

**6\. How do you coordinate estate planning with the portfolio?**
This should go beyond documents—into asset location, beneficiaries, and legacy goals.

**7\. What is your process during market downturns?**
Look for discipline: rebalancing, communication, and behavioral guidance.

**What You’re Listening For**
Clear frameworks. Scenario-based thinking. Coordination across disciplines.

Not generalities or performance anecdotes alone.

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | Information & Risk Disclosure Any discussion of securities, assets, or financial markets in this email is for informational context only and does not represent investment guidance of any kind. name: Teams Cavanagh and Hood
subject: This is a real team effort in Michigan, friend
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Re-elect Chief Justice Megan Kathleen Cavanagh** **
body:
No donation necessary — will you sign your name in support of keeping Michigan's Supreme Court free from the influence of special interests? >>
#
Friend, when it comes to the Michigan Supreme Court elections happening this year, we know more than anyone that keeping state supreme courts free from the influence of special interests will be a team effort — **that's why it's important to us to support Democratic-endorsed Justices who understand what’s at stake and are willing to do the work that needs to be done.**
**And it's why we're so proud to stand alongside Chief Justice Megan Cavanagh and Justice Noah Hood in their work to keep their seats on the bench.**
**[Before we tell you more about them both, we're working hard to build a strong coalition of supporters, but we know a monetary donation isn't always an option! That's why we've created this petition—if you believe that our courts should be free from the influence of special interests, will you add your name to the list of folks standing with us today? ⬇️](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22742?t=1&akid=1644%2E2118727%2EZa0dI3)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22742?t=2&akid=1644%2E2118727%2EZa0dI3)**
[](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22742?t=3&akid=1644%2E2118727%2EZa0dI3)
Friend, let's start with **Chief Justice Megan Cavanagh** : her journey started with a degree in environmental engineering from the University of Michigan. Shortly after discovering her true calling in law, she worked full time while earning her J.D. from Wayne State University Law School. From the start, she forged her own path to the bench, unwavering in the face of any obstacle.
From her work as an appellate attorney to her leadership on Michigan’s highest court, she has remained a dedicated public servant. That determination has defined Megan’s career on the bench, where she’s led the fight to expand access to justice and strengthen trust in our courts.
And as a lifelong Detroiter, **Justice Noah Hood** was raised by a family rooted in public service. His dad, a former Councilmember, and his mom, a judge, taught him the importance of giving back and prioritizing fairness, values he took to Yale, Harvard Law, and dozens of courtrooms. From prosecuting federal cases to serving on one of Michigan’s busiest trial courts and the Court of Appeals, he’s been a role model for public service every step of the way.
Ultimately, we've seen Chief Justice Cavanagh and Justice Hood's commitment to justice, equity, and effective leadership. **And as we continue to see how the state supreme courts are often the last line of defense in preserving democracy in our state, now more than ever is an important time to support candidates who are willing to put the rights and freedoms of Michiganders above all else.**
[**Friend, we want to be clear: we're not asking for a donation today, just for you to add your name in support of Justice Cavanagh and Justice Hood as they work to defend their seats on the Michigan Supreme Court from their challengers. Will you sign our petition today?**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22742?t=4&akid=1644%2E2118727%2EZa0dI3)
**[SIGN OUR PETITION ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22742?t=5&akid=1644%2E2118727%2EZa0dI3)**
Thank you,
Teams Cavanagh and Hood
**Paid for by Re-elect Chief Justice Megan Kathleen Cavanagh** **
Paid for by Committee to Retain Justice Noah P. Hood**

body:
We must stop the epidemic of antisemitic violence and harassment.
| | |
---
Friend,
I am the third Jewish woman and the first former synagogue president ever elected to the United States Senate. Think about that: In our nation’s 250-year history, there were only TWO Jewish women elected to the Senate before I joined.
Like any believer, my faith is deeply tied to who I am, what I fight for, and my role as a lawmaker. It’s part of why I care about the issues that I do, and it means that I bring with me the same struggles that all Jews face. Most prominently, the threat and impact of antisemitism.
**That's why I'm leading the charge in the Senate to combat the increasing levels of violence and harassment Jewish Americans are facing right now.**
[**_Will you please make a gift of $5 or more to support my work in Washington to fight the epidemic of antisemitism across our country?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132384604/624334544/910177728?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk5786-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NmZhOTg1Yy00MTVjLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AAIXpYTScrwWQQC5qnIQahnTo3d7lrrbCCjH0BMDZ1Q=)

---
For me, this fight is personal. When I was just a few years old, I was playing in a hotel swimming pool with my mom while on vacation when a lifeguard on duty told her that we were “dirty” because we were Jewish – and that we had to leave the pool immediately because of it. My parents packed up our things and left that hotel. We never returned. My mom never forgot that interaction, retelling the story for years.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132384606/624334549/1781803786?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5786-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NmZhOTg1Yy00MTVjLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AAIXpYTScrwWQQC5qnIQahnTo3d7lrrbCCjH0BMDZ1Q=)
Nearly every Jewish American has a moment in their lives when they experience or witness antisemitism like that firsthand, and the problem is especially serious today.
Swastika graffiti. Physical assaults and threats. Firebombings. **Multiple** deadly mass shootings. These attacks on Jews are not isolated incidents. They represent a regression toward one of civilization’s darkest chapters.
All of it is wrong, and addressing this kind of violent antisemitism is an issue I’ve been working on since before I came to Congress and throughout my time in the House and Senate. **That is why:**
* I founded the Senate’s first ever Bipartisan Task Force for Combating Antisemitism, which now includes more than half the Senate as members.

* I just introduced the _Jewish American Security Act –_ sweeping legislation to fight antisemitism on college campuses, at Jewish communal institutions, and online. The bill is supported by the American Jewish Committee, the ADL, and the Jewish Council for Public Affairs.

* I successfully pushed the Biden administration to create the first-ever National Strategy to Counter Antisemitism, which took a whole-of-government approach to tackling rising hate.

* I led the effort in Congress to increase the power of the State Department’s Special Envoy to Monitor and Combat Antisemitism by raising the position to the rank of Ambassador.

* I introduced and successfully helped pass legislation reauthorizing the _Never Again Education Act_ to educate communities about the Holocaust.

* I successfully pressured the Trump administration to avoid weakening Coast Guard standards for hate symbols like swastikas.

When I think about this work, I think about being that little girl with her mom again. Every day, I'm trying to help make our country a place where nobody is targeted because of their faith or who they are – whether it’s at a swimming pool, on a college campus, or in the United States military.
**This work is more urgent than ever now that Americans across the country are being targeted, attacked, and killed simply because they are Jewish. That's why I'm counting on your support to power my fight today.**[**_Please, make a generous gift of $5 or more now to help me keep fighting in the Senate to make our country safer and more tolerant for all of us._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132384607/624334550/910177728?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk5786-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NmZhOTg1Yy00MTVjLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AAIXpYTScrwWQQC5qnIQahnTo3d7lrrbCCjH0BMDZ1Q=)

body:
| Peter,

**_I’m no stranger to tough fights._**

Fellow Patriot, there's five days until our primary election.

The next three days will help define the course of our campaign. Either we will enter the general election with the resources we need - or we'll be falling behind.

**These next three days will make or break our campaign. **

My opponents have raised thousands in April from wealthy progressive donors in California, New York, and DC. **They are funded by the liberal coastal elites who think they can buy Montana.**

Chuck Schumer and his allies know what is at stake in this race. They know that this Senate seat is the key to the Majority.

[**That's where you come in, Fellow Patriot.**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=3181ef588c674414a7a2dae27124f0fa&_e=I7OnmzGYG2iMN_gRRhBKFaj1QOWYRyAaF7yBjrAk28TpyP22kmNJhttghMSieIDFEKNgxm4m5U0faztFOBddKcq8OggqgBaOBIMhOxwVth0RLvmJGFSyAxBxBKk09SKZzBj5_cp-kczTEZowrnEmDVtDo8uSY2uIqzfHgU3vA-gcxIqDd4mCT-XWxieP54iUPk6PD24dCNl5cwsQ-q68VINN8h7I1Gq6TdqF1sI-TIFxFpdIUu_2CDFU1kM0OxaKxpJX0B3Z2WGddGmZHuwAky5HmQxuxlT9Qee8C43ckJFd7pgY-lSbqxIrCMHKTCR3ZEGin6OlZ-PA4m5OorzJcjsXqV1Y7KLH4GwQFdz9kM6GqRiDagKad8V7X106L215BST39FN-EWDWrVrPFsbzwW9hC0onvhgZM9z-xEVNXGTNASjapx6iwPIPNU-Nru7Rtd5cGU4bLS1_Xx8fm9JlMaWYHLDeSewbHuBqpQlLzcCNQw5P2s4ausXO3LIpUBJyYKjeas0p93TK7rNWlISl9nIZyJG1UpwP5lniJAFGWxa4ya5evU_LnButD_jH0vbnmAku131vxgWwQvq958eLXgh8Hjq-Ei5b1nlXGlG7eaJZ35OnA2zdA55v91LGsM0ov4xNJ4Jmeyg2xFqnxO-gDY6eelUxq5vc1BKZmVn8f-qi1hvCDkikjJw2DDWvOzUnXN7kkuOAoChVS55iZjl9OQ%3D%3D)

Look, President Trump endorsed me in this race. _I do not take his complete and total endorsement lightly_. He knows that I cannot be bought and I will do what needs to be done in Washington to put Montana and America first. I've spent my career working to cut taxes, prosecute violent criminals, and defend our shared values that make this country great.

President Trump put his trust in me, and I refuse to let him down.

****[I refuse to hand this seat over to Chuck Schumer, who will destroy everything I have fought for and everything that Montanans hold dear.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=3181ef588c674414a7a2dae27124f0fa&_e=I7OnmzGYG2iMN_gRRhBKFaj1QOWYRyAaF7yBjrAk28TpyP22kmNJhttghMSieIDFEKNgxm4m5U0faztFOBddKcq8OggqgBaOBIMhOxwVth0RLvmJGFSyAxBxBKk09SKZzBj5_cp-kczTEZowrnEmDVtDo8uSY2uIqzfHgU3vA-gcxIqDd4mCT-XWxieP54iUPk6PD24dCNl5cwsQ-q68VINN8h7I1Gq6TdqF1sI-TIFxFpdIUu_2CDFU1kM0OxaKrUVo-RTbuyaH_H4of3kciBgfZGij2flrxDdf9YeVqJmgTJtzK9SHgcCcLdf94YLAI0QukxZizDa1xnVp22mBTz0wcBKLPZe1tFX2FhHT43Wno3UMciAN1BjqB3S5NOzAQI2rDDcd94Q69o2-LNr0ttHA1r0otkAmohY8GysPE8WsUKVKxKhJE9AM7uvcgrB0D-iKpvOOp-9jvr5JHbuny_O5dwSfnUNM2l9t7pot2SMjnTfD2Qe-MYL8xRjz4YmSdxBmY82oISm8jJxyffufL2uB9TRvhS6VnVr2Dqp88tokNtcLRBVSZPlikDLqeFr2PIpuZ2tvzDpvsXSBPRC15dLj1cN17IPLRK-8VhySRmVS-OKYhsBCoaTtGLABzQYoUSLHfs4ihB_LC2zZ9-d1xqpSrSPZyDd41tKhFyP4WCGPmbPYqh7yc1L9nA1JDhEYPxsgPLiiH3cyqw1g6ZSsmQ%3D%3D)** **

We only have **three days left** to prove we are in this race to win it.
