name: Dan Goldman
subject: Stop ICE data sharing
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dan Goldman for New York**
body:
I am fighting back. |
---
Peter, The Trump administration is trying to turn federal housing programs into a surveillance tool for ICE. That’s wrong. **And I'm fighting to stop it.** I just introduced the _HUD Data Privacy Act_ to stop the Department of Housing and Urban Development from sharing sensitive personal information with DHS and ICE. _No family should be afraid to apply for housing assistance because they think the government could use their information to target them for deportation._ **But that’s exactly what’s happening.** The Trump administration has pushed unprecedented data-sharing agreements across federal agencies to expand its immigration dragnet and terrorize immigrant communities. Now, HUD is reportedly helping DHS identify immigrants living in federally-assisted housing — creating fear that’s stopping eligible families from seeking the help they need. Housing assistance should help keep families safe and housed — not be used as a weapon for mass deportation efforts. The _HUD Data Privacy Act_ : • **Stops** HUD from sharing sensitive personal data with DHS and ICE
• **Prevents** agencies from misusing housing data for immigration enforcement
• **Protects** families applying for federal housing assistance
• **Ensures** personal information is only used to determine benefit eligibility This fight is going to take public pressure and grassroots support. If you agree that families should be able to access housing assistance without fear,**[add your name today and stand with me in support of the HUD Data Privacy Act.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132389890/624351496/897021491?refcode=AU_DSG_EG_FR_PET_AC_20260530_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkODI2ZDBiZS00OTVjLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kPBKzUEBR8hlHSRot17fZk6mXSj52uxNuSUWqUinH0U=&emci=c426d0be-495c-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=d826d0be-495c-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=13556823)** | [SIGN ON](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132389891/624351497/897021491?refcode=AU_DSG_EG_FR_PET_AC_20260530_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkODI2ZDBiZS00OTVjLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kPBKzUEBR8hlHSRot17fZk6mXSj52uxNuSUWqUinH0U=&emci=c426d0be-495c-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=d826d0be-495c-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=13556823)

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others. In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime. Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q2?refcode=x_260530_MEDbackground_actrs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q2?refcode=x_260530_MEDbackground_actrs] https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q2?refcode=x_260530_MEDbackground_actrs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q2?refcode=x_260530_MEDbackground_actrs]
I became a physician because of my family. I ran for Congress because of my patients.
My mother struggled with mental illness throughout my life. My grandmother helped support our family by bringing us food and getting us clothes from Goodwill. She suffered from diabetes, and she ended up on dialysis and doctors had to amputate both of her legs because of it. She lived with us while recovering. That’s how I learned to dress wounds and to shop for what diabetics could eat.
I became the first person in my family to graduate from college, the first one to become a doctor. I wanted to help people like my mother and my grandmother. I wanted to treat my patients with the respect and dignity they deserved as they navigated what could be the hardest days of their lives.
But after years of watching insurance premiums rise, treating lung conditions from environmental pollution, and seeing families afford less and less of the critical care they needed, I knew I needed to do more.
I wouldn’t accept this as normal. So, I ran for office.
In Congress, I’m fighting to transform our healthcare system into one that leaves no one behind. The bills I’ve co-sponsored include:
* The Keep Kids Covered Act to extend certain eligibility under Medicaid and CHIP
* The Lowering Drug Costs for American Families Act, which would establish limits on prescription costs
* The Seniors Deserve SMARTER Care Act of 2025, which would stop the use of the AI WISeR model under Medicare and stop Trump’s robots from meddling with your healthcare coverage
None of this work is possible without you. Changing our government takes people who refuse to accept the status quo and believe we can do better—especially when it comes to healthcare that’s affordable and humane. Earlier this month, we shared the story of Olivia, a single mother and fourth-grade teacher who applied for DACA renewal in November 2025. Her work permit expired while she waited. She was put on unpaid leave, and her students — including those with special needs — have gone without her for weeks as her family struggles to pay bills with no income.
Unfortunately, Olivia's story is not unique. Right now, families are struggling to keep the lights on, put food on the table, and make ends meet. Thousands of DACA recipients like Olivia are losing their jobs as a result of USCIS processing delays, and federal agents are detaining and deporting DACA recipients despite their active DACA status.
At the same time, Temporary Protected Status (TPS) programs are also being weakened, asylum processes are being blocked and delayed, and refugee resettlement is being slashed. One by one, officials are dismantling the protections many families have relied on for decades.
**Closing our fundraising gap means we can keep organizing to stop these mass delegalization and mass deportation efforts.**
It means we can continue doing the work to protect DACA recipients, meet with Members of Congress to push for a pathway to citizenship, and give witness testimony on the Senate floor.
Your contribution isn't just a donation: it helps sustain a movement that is building a future where we all have what we need to live with safety, stability, and dignity, no matter our immigration status.
_When we come together, we are powerful._

clean_body: 150 donors needed — will you be one? Closing our fundraising gap means United We Dream can keep organizing. | | | Peter, When we come together, we're unstoppable. We're working toward 150 people joining hands with our movement by the end of the month — each one a reminder that we're stronger together. Your contribution fuels our collective efforts to protect immigrant youth and families across this country. Thanks to the generosity of our community members, we're more than halfway there — but May 31 is just around the corner. | | Earlier this month, we shared the story of Olivia, a single mother and fourth-grade teacher who applied for DACA renewal in November 2025. Her work permit expired while she waited. She was put on unpaid leave, and her students — including those with special needs — have gone without her for weeks as her family struggles to pay bills with no income. Unfortunately, Olivia's story is not unique. Right now, families are struggling to keep the lights on, put food on the table, and make ends meet. Thousands of DACA recipients like Olivia are losing their jobs as a result of USCIS processing delays, and federal agents are detaining and deporting DACA recipients despite their active DACA status. At the same time, Temporary Protected Status (TPS) programs are also being weakened, asylum processes are being blocked and delayed, and refugee resettlement is being slashed. One by one, officials are dismantling the protections many families have relied on for decades. Closing our fundraising gap means we can keep organizing to stop these mass delegalization and mass deportation efforts. It means we can continue doing the work to protect DACA recipients, meet with Members of Congress to push for a pathway to citizenship, and give witness testimony on the Senate floor. Your contribution isn't just a donation: it helps sustain a movement that is building a future where we all have what we need to live with safety, stability, and dignity, no matter our immigration status. When we come together, we are powerful. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | Thank you, Ximena, United We Dream Follow us on: | | | | |

| MassGOP Condemns MassDems for allowing Nazi Graham Platner to Recruit at their Convention
Worcester, MA - May 30, 2026 - Shock and disgust are rippling through political circles today as the Massachusetts Democratic Party allowed the campaign of Maine Senate candidate Graham Platner to actively recruit volunteers at its state convention.
"The Massachusetts Republican Party condemns the Mass Dems for allowing Platner's campaign to recruit in Massachusetts. We call on Governor Maura Healey, Senator Ed Markey and all Democrats to openly reject Platner and the Massachusetts Democrat State Committee for allowing this," said Haley Jones, the Executive Director of the Massachusetts Republican Party.
"The Massachusetts Democratic Party's decision to enable a candidate with this kind of hate is outrageous," she added. "Allowing open recruitment for someone with a Nazi tattoo and a history of disturbing conduct is deeply troubling."
Platner's staffers were observed walking signs throughout the event arena, soliciting support, while his team reportedly received table space from Sen. Ed Markey's campaign. This outreach occurs despite Platner's well-documented history, including a chest tattoo long recognized as resembling a Nazi SS "Totenkopf" symbol, along with other controversial past statements and actions that have triggered widespread criticism even within Democratic ranks. ###

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: I’m with Sam
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
We’re just 3 days away.
#
Hi Peter, I’m proud to endorse Sam Forstag for MT-01.
He’s a union leader and smokejumper (a firefighter who parachutes out of planes to battle wildfires!) – **who is now 3 days out from his primary.**
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260530-1.qCO453&refcode=em20260530-6295&t=1&akid=6295%2E420207%2EZIyry1)
[**Will you join me in supporting him today with a grassroots contribution?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260530-1.qCO453&refcode=em20260530-6295&t=2&akid=6295%2E420207%2EZIyry1)
Year after year, working people are falling even further behind – all while big corporations and corrupt politicians in DC rake in huge profits and amass even more wealth. Private equity is buying up housing across the country, while raising rent prices and destroying the housing market for working families who are already stretching their budgets.
It will take growing our numbers in Congress to hold private equity accountable.
As a smokejumper and union leader, Sam understands this reality.
He knows what it’s like to barely scrape by even after working thousands of hours of overtime. And he understands that Americans simply can’t afford for Congress to stay on this path of profit before people.
[**That’s why we need more people like Sam Forstag with me in Congress — and that means providing his team with the resources to reach as many voters as possible ahead of Montana’s June 2 primary.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260530-1.qCO453&refcode=em20260530-6295&t=3&akid=6295%2E420207%2EZIyry1)
National Republicans believe they can just anoint a successor in this race. But you and I, we know the power of a grassroots movement.
Together, we’ll be able to work towards a future where affordable healthcare and housing, protected public lands, and clean air and water are the norm, not the exception. **[I hope you’ll join me today in supporting Sam Forstag →](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260530-1.qCO453&refcode=em20260530-6295&t=4&akid=6295%2E420207%2EZIyry1)**
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260530-1.qCO453&amount=3&refcode=em20260530-6295&t=23&akid=6295%2E420207%2EZIyry1)**
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

clean_body: Make sure Texas has the MAGA voice it deserves in the Senate Make sure Texas has the MAGA voice it deserves in the Senate | | | | | | | Patriot, First, Ken Paxton announced his candidacy for the United States Senate because Texas deserves a real MAGA fighter in Washington, not a career politician collecting favors from lobbyists. Next , the Washington establishment panicked. They spent over $100 million in attack ads trying to destroy Ken before a single general election vote was cast. Then , Ken won anyway. Despite being outspent by more than 20 to 1, he defeated a four-term incumbent senator by 28 points. After Ken won, the Democrats immediately organized. Within two hours of his victory, his opponent James Talarico raised $600,000. Then, Cook Political Report downgraded our race from "Likely Republican" to "Lean Republican" the very same night, handing the left-wing donor base exactly the signal they needed to pour even more money into this race. Talarico has already raised over $40 million total , including $27 million in a single quarter, the largest first-quarter haul ever recorded by a Senate candidate in American history. Now, we need your help. When Ken gets to Washington, he will secure the border, stand with President Trump, protect your Second Amendment rights, and make sure Texas has the MAGA voice it deserves in the Senate. [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260530_1_ak.AQoBNp&amount=5&refcode=em20260530-198&t=2&akid=209%2E127862%2EWJLWdf)
I’m reaching out today because when we look at the map for 2026, Nevada is one of the best opportunities we have to flip a governor’s seat blue.
This race is a toss-up. Polls repeatedly show that the incumbent MAGA governor is vulnerable.
And thankfully, we have a fantastic candidate ready to step into the job: **Attorney General Aaron Ford.**
**[If you are ready to step up for this fight, please contribute $5 — or whatever you can — to support Aaron’s campaign for governor. Winning this race will come down to who can reach the most undecided voters, and that depends on whether Aaron has the resources to do it.](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260530_1_ak.AQoBNp&amount=5&refcode=em20260530-198&t=3&akid=209%2E127862%2EWJLWdf)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260530_1_ak.AQoBNp&amount=5&refcode=em20260530-198&t=22&akid=209%2E127862%2EWJLWdf)**
Aaron’s story mirrors what a lot of working people are going through right now.
He’s lived the struggle — from being a single dad at 21 who relied on food stamps to support his family, to becoming the first Black attorney general in the state’s history.
Aaron takes on opioid profiteers, corporate landlords, and anyone who tries to exploit Nevada families. Now, he’s ready to take this fight to the governor’s mansion. But he can’t win this toss-up race alone.
**In a race this close, even a small resource gap can make the difference, especially when it comes to reaching undecided voters across the state.**
So, I’m personally asking: **[Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can today to help elect Aaron and flip Nevada’s governorship blue?](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260530_1_ak.AQoBNp&amount=5&refcode=em20260530-198&t=23&akid=209%2E127862%2EWJLWdf)**

Take care,
Kamala

The Atlantic: Donald Trump’s Plan to Subvert the Midterms Is Already Under Way [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=053026_2&amount=25]
Team, that headline from The Atlantic says it all.
Donald Trump already promised as part of his 2024 campaign that “we’ll have it fixed so good, you’re not gonna have to vote .” Watching his actions after he lost in 2020 -- lies, denial, rallies, all leading to January 6th -- it's not hard to imagine what he's got in mind for November.
Our states run our elections. But that doesn't mean that MAGA-aligned politicians won't follow his illegal orders to interfere. It doesn't stop him from using ICE agents to intimidate at the polls or threaten eligible voters. And it doesn't stop his Department of Justice from trying to interfere through the courts, especially when more than half of the suppressive lawsuits brought to court this year were brought by the very federal department that's supposed to protect our rights.
None of that takes into account the highly partisan efforts for mid-decade redistricting as well. It's clear that the threats to the next election aren't going to stop. That's where we come in.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132395533/624362621/-1282862128?refcode=WUEFEQ96_20260530_BadQuotes_ALL_v1s1&sourceid=1058953&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhM2NhOTlkOC01MTVjLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=p7up4i2RdPDRFYA9BpbOPfzYa86FJK5OBbCB72Kf8XY=) Peter,

The Republicans running for Congress and for statewide office across the country are out-of-touch, anti-choice extremists.

And that's not exaggerating — they've said it themselves!

And thanks to the work of Powered by People and partner organizations, for the first time in fifty years, Democrats are competing for every single seat in Texas. Thank you, Beto

subject: Direct from the White House
body:
A humbling message...

A humbling message...
| Friend,
---
I’m truly humbled and honored.
---
Direct from the White House, my friend President Trump said:
---
**“JIM JORDAN IS A VERY GOOD FRIEND, FIGHTER, AND WINNER... HE WILL _NEVER_ LET YOU DOWN”**
---
[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckEuK3DAQQE8j79ro4496ocUEY8hiQsgsZinUqrJdwbKEJKevH0w6F5jtK-rxqj7f7bujnY71hwtoqBSbiwXK6OuSY6gbPjequMWzoJVcDjfe3xS3KceS0FcrGzC9FHrRDRoxai6G7i51sxmpfTdoUKMbFejBC9BaoUIQqHqPj4bMJeS94kKLXo7t3eHih6XDDsCNY886fiZwFVs6CgEWH2NKcadKvrQxr81utlpTYeqNyZnJuaA_M7ZPOjJC62Ngcq7owu13zOAOJmdALUByfn8IxIdQ156azxqsdyE5Wg-mpn9dUjA5XJOAQGdgasLgaH_B6pmavn983P4f8eIlntkjU9OvT_vtxXw8Kh6VqennW5MNpCftO5VhZB1fL-eV2tSv_f-PkX8DAAD__1Mtk9o)
---
Coming from the President, those are powerful words.
---
President Trump knows _better than anyone_ the fight I’m waging to drain the swamp and put power back where it belongs – with _YOU_ , the American people.
---
Look, I know talk is cheap in politics. Anyone can make a promise. Anyone can say they’ll fight.
---
**But I’ve got the receipts to back it up**. I’ve been sued. I’ve been spied on. My phone records were seized. And the Left only attacks me, because I fight for YOU.
---
**I’m working with the President – _behind the scenes and all hours of the day_ – to deliver on the agenda you voted for.**
---
And directly from the Oval Office, President Trump laid out the agenda **WE** are fighting for:
---
_**✅Grow our economy
✅Cut taxes
✅Slash burdensome regulations
✅Promote Made-In-The-USA products
✅Champion American energy dominance
✅Keep our border secure
✅Stop migrant crime
✅Defend your constitutional rights
✅Stopping the Radical Left ** _
---
And in just a few months, that same agenda will be voted on AGAIN in the midterm elections.
---
There’s been a lot of doom and gloom about our odds of holding the House. But truth be told, Democrats now ONLY have a **2-POINT** advantage over us.
---
And that’s not because voters suddenly approve of Radical Left ideas._It’s simply because our side isn’t showing up to vote._
---
**If 2% more Republicans show up, we can EASILY erase the Democrats’ 2-point lead. This is a problem we can absolutely fix.**
---
_So, we are going zip code by zip code in our voter file to determine where we need more participation._
---
Friend, we’ve crunched the numbers and with our razor-thin majority now within the margin of error, YOUR voter profile in your zip code is the difference maker.
---
_That’s why I’m reaching out today to simply ask that you VERIFY your GOP voter profile to give me and President Trump the most accurate polling possible to ERASE the Democrats’ 2% LEAD over us._
---

But Montanans saw right through Chuck Schumer’s ploy. Ever since, I’ve been fighting in the Senate for our Montana values. One of our American heroes who I deeply admire is John Brown. And I love the song, “John Brown’s Body” which is sung to the tune of “Glory Hallelujah”.

body:
Please, can you chip in $10?

| [](https://trk.email.goprelease.-79UM8Lg)
---
Peter,
It's Amy, Team Collins' finance director, right here in Maine. I'm reaching out because we have a lot of ground to cover before May 31st at 11:59 PM.

Peter,

Our team recently huddled to finalize our plans for the last few weeks of
this primary. We discussed the recent polling, mapped out our event
schedule, and made a list of everything we need to stay competitive in the
final stretch.

Once we tallied it all up, we realized there’s a gap in our budget.

The truth is, with our opponent having over $6 million in ads airing right
now to boost her name to undecided voters, we forecasted an aggressive
spending plan, and that’s left us with this budget gap.

We could pull back and play it safe, or we can run the campaign this

Hey there, it’s Mark Kelly.
Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run for the Senate.
I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.
But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I had to do something.
So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support, we won that one, too.
I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be here without your help.
We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. The President of the United States threatened my life, personally. I’ve got the entire executive branch bearing down on me right now.
After everything you’ve already done for me, I shouldn’t have to ask you for more. But that’s what I need to do.

Hi friends,
I want to be transparent with you about something that will make a big difference in November: grassroots fundraising.
I'm so proud to be able to finance much of my campaign work myself — I will always invest in what I believe in, and I believe in the people of San Diego more than pretty much anything else on earth!
But we have a big job ahead of us this year, and I'm coming to this team of committed supporters for help, because the truth is that I can't do it alone.
I've been focused on doing everything I can in the House to fight back: introducing a war powers resolution to end the Iran war and bring my constituents home, demanding accountability for this administration’s terror immigration regime, pushing back against cuts to Medicaid and health care to fund Trump's reckless war, and so much more.
But I can't ignore the fact that the fundraising Democrats do now will have a direct impact on whether we win or lose in November.

With New Mexico's history of switching parties every eight years, they are also coming right on schedule to flip this seat!

name: David Seligman
subject: For my Dad.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seligman for AG,
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP62/1/118114/images/unnamed%20copy.jpg]
My father, Paul Allen Seligman, died today.
He was the kind of dedicated, present Dad who always waited up for me when I was a teenager, sitting right by the door with the Denver Post in his lap, reading the Rockies box score for the fifteenth time that day.
He abhorred ego and elitism. One of the worst insults he could give someone was to describe them as a “big shot.” He was in recovery at the end of his life, and he loved going to AA. He loved how it required everyone, no matter their race, class, or other status, to see each other as equals. He'd remind me that all of us are just bags of chemicals: vulnerable, fallible, and deserving of compassion.
He was a cancer doctor, adored by his patients and their families. I heard recently that he was the doctor of choice for many patients who were incarcerated. It meant a lot to them that he treated them with so much dignity. I was really proud to hear that.
He was funny and irreverent, and he didn't always get things right. Neither do I. But the spiritual value he cared about more than any other was the Jewish concept of teshuvah . He believed very deeply, and yet in his own distinct way, in the power of redemption.
My Dad was proud of me and my work. He was proud of how I wanted to stand beside people on their darkest days to help them take on big fights. He was particularly proud of my work taking on profiteering in our healthcare system—he'd been griping daily about corporate greed in healthcare for my entire life. He was really proud of my campaign. He wanted its slogan to be: “Keeping the bastards honest.” That’s what he was all about.
I'm sharing all this for two reasons. First, I'll be grieving my father, consistent with my Jewish traditions, which will interrupt campaign activities a bit over the next week. And second, I'm sharing it because I want you to know about my Dad.
Above all, his life and his death are a reminder that we are all just bags of chemicals floating around on a tiny rock in the middle of the universe, with the smallest little window of time together.
In this campaign and for the decades to come, in honor of my father’s memory, I pledge to help build a politics that recognizes that each of us is a universe, deserving of dignity and love—and I'll continue the fight for a world that delivers those things to everyone. I won’t always get it right, none of us do. He’d want me to remember that. But I pledge to keep trying to do it better every day.
May his memory and the memories of all of those who’ve helped inspire us be a light and a blessing in a world with too much darkness.
With love and solidarity,
David

I heard recently that he was the doctor of choice for many patients who were incarcerated. It meant a lot to them that he treated them with so much dignity. I was really proud to hear that. He was funny and irreverent, and he didn't always get things right. Neither do I. But the spiritual value he cared about more than any other was the Jewish concept of teshuvah . He believed very deeply, and yet in his own distinct way, in the power of redemption. My Dad was proud of me and my work. He was proud of how I wanted to stand beside people on their darkest days to help them take on big fights. He was particularly proud of my work taking on profiteering in our healthcare system—he'd been griping daily about corporate greed in healthcare for my entire life. He was really proud of my campaign. He wanted its slogan to be: “Keeping the bastards honest.” That’s what he was all about. I'm sharing all this for two reasons. First, I'll be grieving my father, consistent with my Jewish traditions, which will interrupt campaign activities a bit over the next week. And second, I'm sharing it because I want you to know about my Dad. Above all, his life and his death are a reminder that we are all just bags of chemicals floating around on a tiny rock in the middle of the universe, with the smallest little window of time together. In this campaign and for the decades to come, in honor of my father’s memory, I pledge to help build a politics that recognizes that each of us is a universe, deserving of dignity and love—and I'll continue the fight for a world that delivers those things to everyone. I won’t always get it right, none of us do. He’d want me to remember that. But I pledge to keep trying to do it better every day. May his memory and the memories of all of those who’ve helped inspire us be a light and a blessing in a world with too much darkness. With love and solidarity, David Paid for by Seligman for AG, Jud Brown, Registered Agent Seligman for AG PO Box 9341 Denver, CO 80209 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please unsubscribe: .

**Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has no business making decisions about our healthcare, Peter.** But while leading Health and Human Services, the damage is already happening — and Donald Trump is backing him every step of the way.

RFK Jr. has overseen massive cuts and chaos at the agencies families depend on to stay healthy. _That has meant:_

❌ Tens of thousands of health workers pushed out at agencies like the CDC, FDA, and NIH — weakening the people we count on to respond to outbreaks and protect public health

❌ Deep cuts to medical research and NIH grants that help doctors find treatments and cures

❌ The dismantling of mental health infrastructure, including major changes to the agency responsible for addiction and mental health services

❌ Political purges of independent health experts and trusted public health leaders

❌ More chaos and uncertainty at the agencies Americans rely on for science-based health guidance

As a doctor, and as your Congresswoman, Kim knows firsthand what the extent of RFK Jr.'s reckless agenda looks like. She's spent years caring for kids and families in Washington state, and has seen what happens when politicians ignore science, when hospitals and clinics lose resources, and when families are left paying the price for bad decisions made by politicians.

clean_body: It's simple: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has no business making decisions about our healthcare, Peter. But while leading Health and Human Services, the damage is already happening — and Donald Trump is backing him every step of the way. RFK Jr. has overseen massive cuts and chaos at the agencies families depend on to stay healthy. That has meant: ❌ Tens of thousands of health workers pushed out at agencies like the CDC, FDA, and NIH — weakening the people we count on to respond to outbreaks and protect public health ❌ Deep cuts to medical research and NIH grants that help doctors find treatments and cures ❌ The dismantling of mental health infrastructure, including major changes to the agency responsible for addiction and mental health services ❌ Political purges of independent health experts and trusted public health leaders ❌ More chaos and uncertainty at the agencies Americans rely on for science-based health guidance As a doctor, and as your Congresswoman, Kim knows firsthand what the extent of RFK Jr.'s reckless agenda looks like. Friend, This is my last email before our primary, and I wanted to take a moment to say **thank you.** From the day I joined this race, I've been met with nothing but support and enthusiasm at every turn. Whether it was with our first poll that showed us in a tight race with Kevin Kiley or the shift post Prop 50, our grassroots coalition was there through it all, and I'm so proud of what we've been able to build. **But this primary election will be our moment of truth.** **Friend, this is our chance to finally elect a representative who embodies our values and will fight the status quo to enact real progressive change in Congress.** We've spent enough time trying to push our representatives to fight for Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and raising taxes on the rich—**this is our campaign's moment, and we have to take it.**

| | | Friend, A few weeks ago, I stood on a stage to receive the Catholic Champion Award. It was a humbling moment.
---

name: Steve Kerrigan
subject: The 2026 Convention is Over!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Hi Peter,
Our 2026 Massachusetts Democratic Convention has concluded! It was an incredible two days, marked by record turnout, remarkable energy, and undeniable momentum. Thank you to all of our delegates, alternates, and add-ons for giving their time and energy, and to our volunteers who helped make this Convention possible.
Now, we are thrilled to announce the candidates who received the endorsement of the Massachusetts Democratic Party in their respective races:
Governor: Maura Healey
Lieutenant Governor: Kim Driscoll
Attorney General: Andrea Joy Campbell
Auditor: Diana DiZoglio
Treasurer: Deborah B. Goldberg
Secretary of State: William F. Galvin
We are also pleased to announce that in the race for Massachusetts Senator, Senator Ed Markey received 72.94 percent of the delegate vote, and Congressman Seth Moulton received 27.06 percent of the delegate vote. Both will appear on the primary ballot this September.
Senator Markey received the official Convention endorsement after receiving greater than 50 percent of the delegate vote.
Though the Convention has passed, our work does not end here. We encourage everyone to get involved, continue organizing and mobilizing to push our party along into a brighter future. Stay engaged and stay determined.
Thank you once more for all the time everyone put in to make this weekend a success.

Unfortunately, we have some bad news...
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4589?t=1&akid=2319%2E5691347%2EMyIBH1)

Peter, with our end-of-month deadline fast approaching, we have an update to share with you:
**With only one day left in May, we’re currently falling short of our monthly goal.**
To make matters worse, a far-right Super PAC announced a $44 million dollar investment in Georgia to defeat Jon. And this is on top of the $11 million Republicans have already spent in this Senate race.
Falling short right now not only puts our resources to respond to these attacks in jeopardy, but also the scale of Jon’s reelection campaign.
We cannot allow these MAGA extremists to take over Georgia. Losing this seat is **NOT** an option.
The good news is it’s not too late to make up the difference and reach our April goal. But we’re going to need **ALL** hands on deck and that includes you, Peter.
$5 may seem small compared to hundreds of millions that will be spent by the GOP here, but when everyone pitches in, _they don't stand a chance_ against a mighty grassroots movement of supporters.
[**$5 is all we’re asking for. But you can give whatever feels right to you. Anything helps. I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground.

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.
---

_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.
---

That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.
---

That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here."

clean_body: This might be a sign of something bigger | | | | | Friend, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. Hi friend — There are two versions of government possible in Rhode Island. **VERSION 1:** The first is the one most people have experienced: “technically” open to everyone, actually navigable only by those who already know how it works. Permits moving faster if you know someone who can help you navigate the system. The official's calendar is filled up with the people who somehow found the right phone number to call and the right time of day to call it. It's a government that has been conditioned, over time, to serve the people with access rather than the people it was built for. In other words, it's not the corruption and malpractice like what we are seeing from the White House. **VERSION 2:** The second is a vision Sue has been building since her first day on the Providence City Council: transparent process, public record, plain-language explanations of how decisions get made. An official whose job is to make government legible to the people it serves — not insiders or corporate interests.

Asking for money isn't easy -- and I mean that. I spent years standing post at the Capitol as a police officer, never asking anyone for anything. But this race is different. What's at stake is different.
**So let me tell you exactly why I 'm asking for $5:**
$5 because we're up against over **$3.75 MILLION** from shady outside groups -- dark money, PAC money, money from people who don't care what happens to the families here.
$5 because keeping this House seat blue matters -- not just for Maryland, but for the entire country. Every seat we win gets us closer to a Democratic House majority. And a Democratic House majority means accountability, not chaos.
$5 because I've seen firsthand what happens when people in power choose self-interest over democracy. I lived it on January 6th. I bled for it. I'm not running for Congress to play games. I'm running to make sure what happened that day never happens again.
$5 because my deadline is tomorrow, and I need to show real grassroots strength before the clock runs out. When I report these numbers, I want our opponents to know that I have an army behind me.
#### **[If even one of these reasons hits home for you, please chip in $5 or more right now. No amount is too small. Every single dollar is a signal that this movement is real. Harry Dunn

clean_body: I have a humble, honest request for you: | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more | | | May 30 | | | | | | | | | | I have a humble, honest request for you: $5. | | ---|---|--- Asking for money isn't easy -- and I mean that. I spent years standing post at the Capitol as a police officer, never asking anyone for anything. But this race is different. What's at stake is different. So let me tell you exactly why I 'm asking for $5: $5 because we're up against over $3.75 MILLION from shady outside groups -- dark money, PAC money, money from people who don't care what happens to the families here. $5 because keeping this House seat blue matters -- not just for Maryland, but for the entire country. Every seat we win gets us closer to a Democratic House majority. And a Democratic House majority means accountability, not chaos. $5 because I've seen firsthand what happens when people in power choose self-interest over democracy. I lived it on January 6th. I bled for it. I'm not running for Congress to play games. I'm running to make sure what happened that day never happens again. $5 because my deadline is tomorrow, and I need to show real grassroots strength before the clock runs out. When I report these numbers, I want our opponents to know that I have an army behind me. Thank you for having my back. It means more than I can say. I wanted to send you a quick update from the final weekend before California’s Primary Election. Right now, organizers and volunteers are out across the state knocking doors, making calls, talking to voters, and doing everything possible to maximize Democratic turnout before Election Day. And honestly? The energy on the ground has been incredible. From Orange County to the Inland Empire, from the Central Valley to competitive suburban districts, volunteers are showing up ready to fight for Democrats up and down the ballot. But with only days left before the primary, we need to keep scaling up these operations through Election Day. = = Every conversation with voters matters right now. Because once voters cast their ballots, there is no second chance to persuade them. No extra weekend. No extra organizing window. And while Democrats are organizing aggressively across California, Republicans and outside groups are doing the exact same thing to protect vulnerable GOP seats and suppress Democratic turnout wherever they can. And polling suggests some of their dirty tricks might be working! The good news is that we know this work makes an impact because we’ve seen it firsthand. But organizing at this scale takes real resources during the final sprint. Printing literature costs money. Expanding phonebanks costs money. Supporting organizers and volunteers across California costs money. From my ancestral homelands to the halls of Congress, I’ve worn my traditional clothing with pride, honoring where I come from and the people who made my journey possible. At the White House Tribal Nations Summit, I wore my beaded moccasins in solidarity with Indigenous people across the country. Trump’s nominees are handed the softest possible test — questions about

These nominees choose to avoid historical fact and hide behind rehearsed
non-answers and legal wordplay — dodging any answer that might upset
Trump.

Senator Richard Blumenthal called it what it is:

“I am insulted as a member of this body that you won’t tell us the truth...
You’ve all been carefully rehearsed... I think you failed the test.”

He’s right. They failed — deliberately.

These nominees are demonstrating loyalty. They’re signaling that they’ll
protect Trump’s lies, excuse political violence, and stay silent when
democracy is attacked, all in exchange for a lifetime seat on the bench.

And here’s the most enraging part... Nineteen Senate Democrats are voting to
confirm these judges.

Nineteen. Let that sink in.

And every vote “yes” helps pack the courts with Trump cronies — judges who
won’t defend elections, won’t condemn insurrection, and won’t protect our
rights when it counts.

Demand Justice PAC is done pretending this is normal. We’re calling out
the nominees and the Democrats enabling them. Because letting this slide
is how democracy erodes.

Democrats from every corner of the state: organizers, candidates, volunteers, elected officials, public servants, people who have been doing this work quietly for years without much recognition and without much reward. People who live in a state that gets written off by national Democrats before campaign season even starts, and who keep showing up anyway.

I said something on stage l that I want to say to you directly: I believe we have to compete everywhere. Not just in the states we're _supposed_ to win. Everywhere.

The TTV Weekly Wrap Up

Legislatures are maneuvering. Voters are asking harder questions. And across the country, Americans are realizing that election law isn’t some distant political issue anymore — it’s shaping the future of representation, accountability, and trust in real time.

At the same time, the political landscape itself keeps shifting beneath our feet. Establishment figures are falling, grassroots movements are growing louder, and citizens are paying closer attention to what happens behind closed doors in statehouses, courtrooms, and election offices nationwide.

Lead From Where You Stand
-------------------------

---------------
The Bottom Line
---------------

The political establishment is shifting. Fast.

Courts are redrawing the rules on redistricting. States are rewriting election law. Questions surrounding mail-in voting, voter roll transparency, and election authority are intensifying. Meanwhile, voters are sending a message loud and clear in Republican primaries: the grassroots is done with business as usual.

And none of this is happening in isolation. Every court ruling, every map fight, every primary upset, and every election law battle is shaping the future of representation and power in America.

---------------
What You Can Do
---------------

* Call to action: if you or someone you know can obtain the Kentucky voter rolls, please reach out to us ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/o8up29nr7ksqh6ml585hvhqe5m850cohde5z6/owhkhqhwvo49griv/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvY29udGFjdA== ).

Contact us ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/o8up29nr7ksqh6ml585hvhqe5m850cohde5z6/owhkhqhwvo49griv/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvY29udGFjdA== ) and we'll let you know about next steps. (P.S. - if you've already reached out, thank you!!)
* Cliché but...see something, say something. Are you receiving ballots or voter-related mail you didn't request? Take pictures and send us details via our report line ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/o8up29nr7ksqh6ml585hvhqe5m850cohde5z6/7qh7h8h97z0lw0az/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvaGVscGxpbmU= ).
* Stay informed on election legislation ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/o8up29nr7ksqh6ml585hvhqe5m850cohde5z6/z2hghnhevwo6peap/aHR0cHM6Ly9sZWdpdHJhY2sub3Jn ). LegiTrack now features a "redistricting tag" so you can find every related bill we're tracking.
* Revisit 2020 evidence and news. It's hard to go back, but 2020 was a blessing in disguise. You woke up, you got engaged, and you'll never be the same. Keep up with all that is emerging during the era of gaslighting.
* Get involved locally ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/o8up29nr7ksqh6ml585hvhqe5m850cohde5z6/p8heh9h40x96gguq/aHR0cHM6Ly9jb21tdW5pdHkudHR2bm93Lm9yZw== ). Join grassroots efforts in your state, attend local meetings, support transparency efforts, and help educate others on the issues impacting their communities.
* Get out and vote. The evidence is clear: if you make the effort, you see the results. Shut out the lies that tell us that our vote doesn't matter.
* Pray for wisdom, courage, and discernment. No matter where you stand politically, this is a defining moment for the country — and for the people entrusted with stewarding it. These 50 days from May 17th to July 4th are critical for our nation.
* Support our work ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/o8up29nr7ksqh6ml585hvhqe5m850cohde5z6/x0hph6he63n293h5/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcvZG9uYXRl )if you’re able. Every volunteer hour, conversation, share, and donation helps strengthen the movement for transparency, accountability, and citizen engagement.

---------------
Until Next Week
---------------

Remember— you do not need a law degree, a title, or permission, to make a difference. You need awareness. You need discernment. You need the willingness to stay engaged when it would be easier to tune out. Real change rarely begins in Washington. It begins in homes, churches, communities, conversations, and citizens who refuse to surrender the future of their country to apathy.

True the Vote will keep doing our part. With faith, steadiness, and people like you willing to stand shoulder to shoulder, we'll keep pressing forward — for transparency, accountability, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness, the America we were given, and the one we mean to keep.

Ever onward.

Thank You that silence does not mean abandonment and waiting does not mean You have forgotten us. When we cannot see movement, remind us that You are still working behind the scenes in ways we do not yet understand. Strengthen us when our faith feels weak. Steady us when fear and discouragement try to distort our perspective. Teach us to rest in Your presence instead of being consumed by our circumstances. And help us trust You when the outcome feels unsettled and the future feels unclear.

Father, breathe hope back into those who have weary hearts. Let peace rise above panic and faith rise above fear. Remind us that even in the waiting, You are still working. And even in the silence, You are still God. In Jesus’ Name, Amen.

subject: I knew this wouldn’t be easy
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
But I never thought, after 25 years in the Navy and NASA, that the President of the United States would call for my arrest and execution.
#

Back when I first decided to run for U.S. Senate, I knew it wouldn’t be easy. I knew there’d be a ton of travel, events, and time spent on the phone and away from my family.
I knew I’d have to face millions and millions of dollars being spent against me and see my opponents try to drag my name through the mud. I even knew that Trump would probably go after me, personally.
But I never thought, after 25 years in the Navy and NASA, that the President of the United States would call for my arrest and execution. I prepared myself for a lot, but even that was beyond my wildest imagination.
Through it all though, I learned that millions of people I might never meet would see all of that and still have the courage to stick with me.
That’s why your support means so much to me. And it’s why I tell you so often that I can’t do this without you. Donations of $5 here or $10 there from grassroots supporters are the largest source of donations we have, by far.
None of this happens without you, and that’s why I’m coming around to this request:

# [Diner Conversations Save the Country](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=7534176&post_id=199918906&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk5OTE4OTA2LCJpYXQiOjE3ODAxNzk5OTAsImV4cCI6MTc4Mjc3MTk5MCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTc1MzQxNzYiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.WrHV7XmZV45ANg8MOeiwF4SNhFM4ZMZZLTZH3XkVuQI)
### In an era full of video calls and disconnect, we need to make sure everyone is a part of the conversation.
May 30
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=7534176&post_id=199918906&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk5OTE4OTA2LCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTc4MDE3OTk5MCwiZXhwIjoxNzgyNzcxOTkwLCJpc3MiOiJwdWItNzUzNDE3NiIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.0KU7mXLaM25SK-g3aHHAjRh-TCuy4tTSS9XX7C4gfd4&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)
---
| | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=7534176&post_id=199918906&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk5OTE4OTA2LCJpYXQiOjE3ODAxNzk5OTAsImV4cCI6MTc4Mjc3MTk5MCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTc1MzQxNzYiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.WrHV7XmZV45ANg8MOeiwF4SNhFM4ZMZZLTZH3XkVuQI)
---
| | [](https://substack..KxvUdg8Qxo-Hkc0DxPfZxAJnRGYDmqqNaAl51Weujvo?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/mikefortennessee/p/diner-conversations-save-the-country?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

These are the people Washington has forgotten. Seniors who worked their entire lives, paid into the system, did everything they were supposed to do, and are now sitting at diner tables wondering if their Social Security is safe, if their prescriptions will be affordable next month, if anyone in Congress even remembers they exist.
I leaned across that table and I listened. Really listened. Not to get a soundbite, but because these conversations are the whole reason I'm running.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6f7dc81a-8eb0-47bd-9d8c-9e40857c70c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Scott DesJarlais has had 14 years to sit at tables like this one. To hear these stories. To go back to Washington and fight for the people telling them. Instead he missed nearly 5% of his votes, introduced the fewest bills of anyone in the Tennessee delegation, and has zero laws to show for his time in office. **Zero.**
**I am committed to making sure everyone is a part of the fight for a better tomorrow, today![ Let's work together to keep the fight alive before the month is over!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4eb4179f-148f-4edd-a751-7f5a25e1446e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[CHIP IN $20!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4eb4179f-148f-4edd-a751-7f5a25e1446e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And while he was busy not showing up, the cost of prescription drugs kept climbing. Rural hospitals kept closing. Fixed incomes kept shrinking. The people at this table didn't get a single bill fought for on their behalf. They got silence from a man who was too busy protecting his seat to do anything worth keeping it for.
These people deserved better than that. They deserve a representative who shows up... not just at election time, but every single day in between.
My name is Mike Cortese, and that's my promise. Not to a party. Not to a donor. **To them, and** _**you**_**.**

body:
I’ve never backed down from a tough fight. I won’t start now.
# [](https://act.alexvindman.com/go/1100?t=1&akid=613%2E3892029%2E9l7oet)

Peter, I need to be direct:
_My Senate election in Florida will decide whether Democrats win back the majority in 2026. End of story._
The political elites installed Ashley Moody to pass their MAGA agenda through the Senate. They will spend whatever it takes to protect her and their rigged system.
This is going to be a tough fight, and I can’t win this alone.
Will you rush in $3 to help us defeat Trump’s handpicked candidate and restore checks and balances in the Senate? Do it before my May fundraising deadline ends tomorrow at midnight:
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/av-em-q22026**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/av-em-q22026?refcode=em260530-2-c&refcode2=613_3892029_9l7oet&akid=613%2E3892029%2E9l7oet)
Let me explain why I made the decision to run for the United States Senate and why your support is so crucial, especially today.
I served for 21 years in the United States Army. As a Lieutenant Colonel and in combat, it was my job to lead hundreds of people in high-pressure situations where lives were at stake.
I swore an oath to protect this country when I first volunteered, and I work to honor that oath every day.
So when I overheard Donald Trump’s corrupt phone call with Ukraine, I knew it was my duty to report that call. That decision led to Trump’s first impeachment — and the president’s revenge campaign against me and my family.
It was a risk to report that phone call — one that ultimately cost me my military career. But my oath to this country comes first. That’s why I am running for Senate.
**Our system is rigged, and Ashley Moody was handpicked by the political elites who rigged it.**
She has screwed over homeowners by caving to big insurance companies and traded over two million dollars in her corporate stock — while she had access to insider information only Congress gets.
We must do better. I stepped up when our country needed a soldier, and I’m stepping up now because we need fighters in the United States Senate.
The latest polling shows us within striking distance of flipping Florida’s Senate seat, but special interests are going to pour in unlimited amounts of money to protect Ashley Moody. To overcome these attacks, I need you by my side.
[**Will you chip in $3 so we can take back Florida and flip the Senate majority? My end-of-month deadline passes in less than 36 hours:**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/av-em-q22026?refcode=em260530-2-c&amount=3&refcode2=613_3892029_9l7oet&akid=613%2E3892029%2E9l7oet)

My friends, California’s Primary Election Day is on Tuesday, and I’ve been reflecting on what we’ve built together these last five years while I’ve served as Attorney General of California — and critically, all the work that still lies ahead.
We’ve built a wall of protection around this state. A legal fortress around our freedoms and our values that no one — not even the most unlawful president — can tear down.
From Day One, my vision for the California Department of Justice has been that we keep Californians safe and serve as the nation’s largest and most powerful check on the abuse of power. And we’ve done it:
We’ve put public safety first, and successfully combatted fentanyl traffickers, gun traffickers, and human traffickers. We’ve held greedy corporations accountable, from Big Pharma’s fraudulent billing practices to Big Oil’s assault on our environment to Big Landlords colluding to drive up prices. We’ve secured justice for the innocent targets of fraudsters and schemesters.
Through it all, we’re defending our foundational rights and freedoms from the ongoing assault of a federal government and President who are hell-bent on tearing them down.
And importantly, we are securing the California Dream for the next generation.
That’s what this job is all about, and I’m not done fighting.
My parents fought for democracy and human rights, and they taught me to believe that people power is the most potent power.
From the civil rights movement to the farmworkers’ movement, and in the fight for democracy in countries around the world, we, the people, are responsible for transforming our future.
This is work worth doing, every way you look at it.
I am fiercely committed to doing whatever it takes to protect Californians — which is why I’m incredibly proud to be on the ballot for re-election this year.
Together, we will stop unlawful power grabs from the federal government, defend our immigrant communities, protect reproductive freedom, and stand up to abuse of power wherever it appears.
Because we have proven that when California fights, we win.
But no single person can do these things alone — I will need you with me to continue this work.
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26] Will you support my re-election campaign before our May end-of-month deadline? Every single dollar we raise right now helps us build a stronger grassroots movement to protect our freedoms — and win in November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]

We are at our strongest against the rising tides of tyranny when we stand together, each of us clear-eyed and committed to the roles we must play.
I’m ready. And I’m profoundly grateful to have you with me in this movement for freedom and justice for all.
Thank you for everything.
—Rob

It seems like every election is framed as the most important we've faced.
But with the attacks on our democracy and our fundamental right to vote, especially in the wake of the Supreme Court's decisions that dismantle the Voting Rights Act, the importance of the midterms cannot be understated .
We have no time to waste. Chip in $35 or more right now to defend our fundamental right to vote! >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=053026_4&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Team
The Constitution places the authority to run elections squarely with the states and Congress – NOT with the federal government.
But now, the President has issued another executive order imposing sweeping new federal control over election administration.
Make no mistake, Team, this is yet another unlawful attempt by this MAGA administration to sow confusion and distrust ahead of the fall midterm elections.
We're doing everything in our power to fight back and protect the right to vote , including:
➜ Registering eligible voters
➜ Putting election information directly in the hands of voters
➜ Combating election misinformation
➜ Advocating at every level to keep our elections truly free and fair
Team, it will take massive resources to stand up to this new executive order in time to make a difference before the midterm elections. We need your help ASAP: Will you chip in $35 or whatever you can afford right now? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=053026_4&amount=35]

This is outrageous, Peter — Trump’s EPA is moving to roll back limits
on toxic PFAS, or “forever chemicals,” in drinking water. These are chemicals
linked to cancer, kidney and liver damage, hormone disruption, and more. We urgently need your help to protect the health of our communities. Renew your LCV membership for $15 to power our work to stand up to Trump’s toxic agenda >> https://links.messages.lcv. PFAS chemicals don’t break down and disappear. They contaminate drinking water
supplies for generations, putting millions of families at risk. This move hurts everyone— Republicans and Democrats, in every state. Last election, Trump had support
from Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s "MAHA" backers, in part because of promises to
remove chemicals from our food and water. But after this PFAS announcement — and another high-profile decision to expand
the use of dangerous glyphosate, aka Roundup — support for Trump from MAHA
voters is collapsing. LCV is seizing this moment for action: we’re mobilizing to build grassroots
power, reach voters across the country, and take Trump to task for putting
corporations ahead of public health. But this work depends on supporters like you, who are willing to stand up for

Hi friend, sorry to reach out again, but we hope you know that we only send these emails for good reason.
In fact, emails like these are a lifeline for our campaign — a huge chunk of all the money we raise comes from grassroots donations that are made through emails.
